A substrate containing a CF3 substituent afforded product 3p in 51% yield, whereas an amide bearing a free N−H bond failed to give the desired product 3q.

The polyfluoroarene scope included tetrafluoroanisole, pentafluorotoluene, keto- and cyano-substituted polyfluorobenzenes, and polyfluoropyridines; 1,2,3,5-tetrafluorobenzene gave an unsatisfactory yield.
A monosubstituted olefin substrate did not afford the desired product, and a beta-hydride-elimination product was the major product.

The authors propose oxidative addition of Pd(0) to the substrate C−I bond, intramolecular Heck formation of an alkylpalladium intermediate, silver-mediated iodide abstraction, concerted metalation–deprotonation of the polyfluoroarene, and reductive elimination.
The paper reports palladium-catalyzed meta-selective C-H olefination of aromatic carbonyl compounds directed through a noncovalent hydrogen-bonding interaction.
With acetophenone, the reaction without a hydrogen-bond donor showed poor reactivity and o/m/p = 1/0.8/0.2, whereas donor L9 gave 69% yield and o/m/p = 1.0/4.0/1.0.
Thiourea L14 failed to provide the desired C-H olefination products.

Removing the donor's nitrile group significantly reduced reactivity and regioselectivity, while methylating both urea N-H positions diminished yield and meta selectivity.
NMR and IR measurements support hydrogen-bond association between urea L9 and acceptors, including TPPO, DMSO, benzophenone, aromatic aldehyde, ester, and amide partners.
The ketone and aldehyde scope tolerated methoxy substituents and para fluoro, chloro, and trifluoromethoxy groups; the latter group gave 52-65% yields and regioselectivity up to greater than 20/1.

Scope limitations included sharply reduced meta selectivity for meta-substituted or bulky-substituted substrates and only trace olefination for substrates bearing additional NO2, CF3, or ester electron-withdrawing groups.
The reported olefin-partner scope included olefins bearing ketone, ester, aldehyde, amide, and multiple-fluoro functionality, as well as olefins derived from naturally occurring terpenes.

L9 increased product formation and meta selectivity under the reported conditions: no more than 20% olefinated product formed without L9 after 20 h, close to 65% formed with 1.0 equivalent L9, and 0.5 equivalent L9 gave 53% yield with o/m/p = 1/3.3/1.
A measured kinetic isotope effect of kH/kD = 3.93 led the authors to propose that C-H bond cleavage is probably rate-determining.
The authors report a DNA-compatible carbonylative Suzuki coupling of DNA-conjugated (hetero)aryl iodides with (hetero)aryl boronic acids that produces di(hetero)aryl ketones.
In the model reaction, the desired diaryl ketone was accompanied by proto-deiodination, direct Suzuki coupling, and hydroxycarbonylation side products.

Among the initial conditions screened, detectable desired ketone formation required Mo(CO)6, K3PO4, and acetonitrile; ligand-free Pd(OAc)2 gave 18% conversion, with direct Suzuki coupling and hydroxycarbonylation as major side products.

The optimized model conditions used Pd(OAc)2, a Mo(CO)6-derived CO source, acetonitrile, pH 6.5 MOPS buffer without added base, and 60 °C for 60 minutes; the table reports up to 80% LC-MS conversion for the short-DNA model.
Pivalic acid failed to suppress direct Suzuki coupling and caused observable damage to the DNA tag.
On elongated DNA, adding sodium ascorbate and lowering the Pd(OAc)2 loading increased desired-ketone conversion from 40% to 61%.
The boronate scope included electronically varied, sterically hindered, fused-bicyclic, and heteroaryl boronic acids, generally with good conversion and only trace direct Suzuki product.
Pinacol boronate esters performed similarly to boronic acids but produced somewhat more hydroxycarbonylation; several functional groups were tolerated, while an azolic Boc group was cleaved.

Electrophile-scope limitations included no observed product for the sterically hindered ortho-methoxy substrate with p-methylphenylboronic acid and only moderate ketone conversion from an on-DNA pyridinyl iodide, with significant proto-deiodination.
The authors suggest that an on-DNA acyl-palladium complex could furnish di(hetero)aryl ketones if competing hydroxycarbonylation were sufficiently suppressed.
Post-reaction DNA showed no observable damage by Bioanalyzer and was successfully amplified and quantified by qPCR.
The authors report a blue-light-induced tandem alkyl radical addition and oxidation of alkenyl borates that produces diverse ketones.

Pure oxygen decreased the yield of 3a to 46%, which the authors attributed to accelerated direct oxidation of the alkenyl borate substrate.

The authors interpret stereochemical errors and relative catalyst activities as being consistent with a higher back-skip-to-insertion rate ratio for the heterocene catalyst.

Benzyl α,β,β-trifluoroacrylate undergoes carbon-carbon bond-forming addition-elimination with Grignard or dialkylzinc reagents in the presence of a copper(I) salt, producing β-substituted α,β-difluoroacrylates in high yields with high Z selectivity; trialkylaluminum reagents also give addition-elimination products in good yields but with lower stereoselectivity.

For phenylmagnesium bromide, 0.13 equivalents of CuBr substantially improved product yield and Z selectivity: product 2a was obtained in 94% NMR yield, 90% isolated yield, and E/Z = 14:86, compared with 5% yield and E/Z = 43:57 without CuBr.

Under the typical phenylmagnesium bromide procedure, 0.13 equivalents of CuBr and 1.3 equivalents of PhMgBr were used in THF at -78 °C for 1 hour, and chromatographic isolation furnished benzyl 2,3-difluoro-3-phenylacrylate in 90% yield.

The tested Grignard scope included aryl, alkyl, benzyl, alkenyl, and naphthyl partners, with partner-dependent efficiency: 2-methoxyphenyl gave no arylated product and 4-trifluoromethylphenyl gave 6% yield. Allylmagnesium chloride does not follow the desired selective addition-elimination pathway, instead furnishing a 1,2-adduct and a 1,2:1,4-bis-adduct in 74% and 22% yields, respectively.

Diisopropylzinc furnished the product in 97% isolated yield with E/Z = 2:98, whereas dimethylzinc and diphenylzinc gave no expected product; the authors also reported that dialkylzinc reagents prepared in situ by literature methods were inefficient for this reaction.

Trialkylaluminum reactions are strongly solvent- and temperature-dependent and generally less Z-selective: triethylaluminum gave no product in THF or ether at -78 °C, but gave 75% yield and E/Z = 43:57 in hexane at -20 °C; trimethylaluminum failed, while triisobutyl- and tri-n-octylaluminum reacted.

The authors propose that an in situ generated organocuprate forms a π-complex involving the alkene and carbonyl oxygen, undergoes oxidative addition to an enolate-like intermediate, and then eliminates metal fluoride before reductive elimination gives the Z product.
The paper reports silver-mediated direct radiofluorination of alkynes with no-carrier-added [18F]AgF to prepare [18F]alkenyl fluorides.

[18F]KF·K222 alone did not produce the model product, adding AgOTf to that fluoride source gave a lower yield, water was required as the proton source, and a larger amount of water sharply reduced reactivity.
Alkynyl ketones, an alkynyl amide, and an alkynyl sulfone underwent the reaction in moderate-to-good radiochemical yields.
The reported protocol tolerated ether, cyano, isoindoline-1,3-dione, and triazole functionality, and the substrates described in that scope passage gave good RCYs and excellent regioselectivities.
Most tested substrates showed high Z/E selectivity with no detected E-isomer radio-HPLC peak, but products 2i and 2n were exceptions.
The authors suspect that substrates 1i and 1n, which contain strong electron-withdrawing groups, may undergo direct nucleophilic hydrofluorination with silver as an intermediary.
The method was applied to tyrosine and menthol derivatives; the tyrosine derivative was obtained in moderate RCY.
The proposed mechanism consists of trans-addition of silver [18F]fluoride to the alkyne to form silver intermediate A, followed by AcOH-mediated protodemetalation to give the fluoroalkene.

Increasing reaction time, NFSI amount, or reaction temperature did not improve conversion of the model reaction.

对于吡唑 7，反应主要生成副产物 7b，目标氟代吡唑 7a 仅占 5%（LC-MS 检测）。

Other tested N-alkyl substrates 12-18 underwent lithiation/fluorination to give desired products in 50-73% yield, with LDA replacing n-BuLi for selected halogenated substrates to avoid halogen-lithium exchange.

The general fluorination procedure used pyrazole, 1.05 equivalents of n-BuLi or LDA, and 1.2 equivalents of NFSI in dry THF, with lithiation at -65 °C, NFSI addition and two-hour reaction at -75 °C, followed by 12 hours at room temperature.

The trifluoromethylation scope included substituted aromatic ketones in good to very good yields, while a thienyl substrate gave a diminished 45% yield; benzyl- and alkyl-derived substrates gave products in 73% and 76% yields, respectively.

Control experiments established strong dependence on blue light and sensitivity to TEMPO: removal of blue light produced no 2a or other products, while TEMPO suppressed 2a and afforded product 6 in 23% yield.

Long-chain fluorinated sulfinate sources furnished fluorinated α,β-unsaturated ketones in 69–81% yields; the authors attributed these products to dehydrofluorination of corresponding α-difluoromethyl ketones.
Sodium benzenesulfinate and sodium methylsulfinate reacted without iridium catalyst or blue light to give α-sulfonyl ketones in 83% and 87% yields, respectively.

The study investigated the kinetics and mechanisms of reactions of five quinones, including tetrafluoro-p-quinone, with pi-nucleophiles and amines, and observed products arising from attack at carbonyl C, carbonyl O, and conjugate positions.
Fluoranil gave different reaction outcomes depending on the pi-nucleophile: 1,2-addition with terminal silyl ketene acetal 2a and an O-attack product with 2c.

With cyclic silyl ketene acetals, fluoranil showed competing mono- and disubstitution or selective substitution: reaction with 2d gave mainly C-1 addition, a trace of monosubstitution, and a disubstitution product isolated in 27% yield, whereas reaction with 2e gave only the substitution product.
The reaction of fluoranil 1d with enamine 2h gave a complex mixture of products that was not analyzed.

For the tetrahalogenated quinones, amines reacted exclusively through attack at a halogen-substituted conjugate position leading to substitution, while silyl ketene acetals could partition among substitution, carbonyl-C attack, and carbonyl-O attack.

Kinetic measurements were performed at 20 degrees C in dichloromethane for pi-nucleophiles and in acetonitrile for amines; the quinone reactions with amines 2i-o generally followed second-order kinetics.

Steric demand of the nucleophile strongly affected chemoselectivity: tetrahalogenated para-quinones underwent carbonyl-C attack with terminal ketene acetal 2a, increasing shielding promoted substitution at C-2, and still greater steric demand promoted attack at O.

Partial rate constants for attack at C-halogen positions correlated with the Mayr nucleophilicity parameters, and the derived electrophilic reactivity of those positions was nearly independent of whether the reaction partner was an amine or ketene acetal.

All measured amine reactions and most pi-nucleophile reactions at quinone carbon centers were several orders of magnitude faster than the fastest conceivable SET processes, supporting polar pathways; reactions involving O attack had rate constants compatible with SET, without establishing SET as their mechanism.

For substitution of 2,5-dichlorobenzoquinone 1b by amine 2i, the reported potential-energy surface contained no intermediate and indicated an asymmetric concerted pathway in which C–Cl bond breaking starts before C–N bond formation is complete.

The authors proposed a semiquantitative feasibility rule that electrophile-nucleophile reactions at 20 degrees C can be expected when E + N exceeds -5, while emphasizing that the relationship typically has only factor-of-10-to-100 confidence and does not include steric effects.
Diazo quinones and phenols undergo dirhodium-catalyzed C(sp2)−O cross coupling to furnish diaryl ethers in moderate to high yields under mild, neutral conditions.
For the model reaction, Rh2(esp)2 was the most effective tested catalyst; DCM at 40 °C gave 89% NMR yield, whereas room temperature gave 77%.
Cu(OTf)2, Co(TPP), and [Ru(p-cymene)Cl2]2 produced 20–50% diazo quinone conversion after 24 hours but no diaryl ether product.
The authors attribute the superior effectiveness of Rh2(esp)2 to the stability and catalytic activity imparted by its bridging bis-carboxylate ligand.

The reported phenol scope furnished diaryl ethers in 67–89% yields and tolerated aryl bromide, aryl iodide, boronic ester, ester, alkene, alkyne, and phenyl functionality; pyridinol gave product in moderate yield.

A range of unsubstituted, monosubstituted, and disubstituted diazo quinones furnished diaryl ethers in 48–93% yields, including an 81% yield from a sterically hindered di-tert-butyl-substituted diazo quinone.
Ortho-diazo quinones did not undergo the cross-coupling reaction, whereas diazonaphthoquinone analogues were reactive and gave diaryl ethers in moderate to high yield.
Competing phenolic C–H functionalization was absent in most cases but occurred for products 3k and 5e in 8% and 69% yield, respectively.
The authors suggest that, under the reported conditions, the quinoid carbene generally reacts more readily with phenolic O–H bonds than with C–H bonds.

The proposed mechanism invokes Rh2(esp)2-mediated diazo quinone decomposition to a Rh(II)-quinoid carbene, followed by either O–H insertion or oxonium-ylide formation, proton transfer, aromatization, diaryl ether formation, and catalyst regeneration.
Diketene reacted with anhydrous HF at −60 °C to form acetoacetyl fluoride; the authors initially report the keto tautomer as the only tautomer under these conditions.
In a later NMR discussion, the authors describe the keto tautomer of acetoacetyl fluoride as predominant, rather than exclusive, when diketene was dissolved in anhydrous HF at −60 °C.

A calculated pathway from C=C-protonated diketene had an electronic activation energy of 9.2 kJ/mol and released 11.0 kJ/mol of electronic energy upon ring opening.
On the basis of the calculated small barrier, the authors expect ring opening to occur readily after protonation of the diketene C=C bond, even at −60 °C.

The authors propose ring opening through protonation at either the lactone oxygen or the C=C bond, formation of an acyl cation, and subsequent fluoride addition to the carbonyl moiety; they favor C=C protonation because calculations identify it as the more basic site.

The paper reports palladium-catalyzed direct arylation of electron-poor fluorinated arenes under biphasic conditions at room temperature, with reported yields up to 99%.
Optimization with 4-iodotoluene and pentafluorobenzene found EtOAc/water (2.5:1) superior to the tested single organic solvents, increasing the yield to 83%.
The EtOAc/water ratio had a narrow optimum around 2.5:1; deviations produced lower conversion.
Ligand identity strongly affected performance: RuPhos gave 91% over 16 h, DavePhos enabled a 5 h reaction, and MePhos furnished product 3 in 90% isolated yield after 2 h.
Silver carbonate was necessary under the tested optimized conditions: omitting it gave no conversion and recovered starting materials.
The authors attributed the role of silver(I) to plausible iodide abstraction from a Pd(II) complex, generating an electrophilic cationic palladium intermediate.

The authors reasoned that biphasic conditions completely solubilize inorganic reaction components and noted that the base implicated in concerted metalation-deprotonation is only sparsely soluble in organic solvents.

The aryl iodide scope tolerated electron-withdrawing ketone, ester, and trifluoromethyl substituents, electron-donating para and ortho substituents, sterically demanding substrates, and 5-iodoindole, with reported yields from 78% to 99% for the examples described.

Tetrafluoro- and trifluoroarenes participated in the coupling; the described tetrafluorinated products were obtained in 91-98% yields, and the described trifluorinated arenes gave only monoarylation products in 81-99% yields.
The reported 2-chlorothiophene examples were run at 60 °C, giving products 20 and 21 in 77% and 61% yields; at ambient temperature, 2-chlorothiophene gave 31% after 16 h.

TMPMgCl·LiCl metalated three fluorobenzonitrile isomers regioselectively at room temperature before trapping with electrophiles.

During formylation of the metalated 4-fluorobenzonitrile derivative, fluorine was displaced by in situ generated magnesium dimethylamide, furnishing an arylamine in 91% yield; changing the formylating agent gave a different outcome.
Organo­magnesium intermediates were transmetalated with ZnCl2 and coupled with iodoarenes using Pd(PPh3)4, giving two reported products in 90% and 92% yields.

Changing from TMPMgCl·LiCl to the zinc TMP base changed the functionalized position of 3,4-difluorobenzonitrile from C5 to C2 under the reported conditions.
Fluorinated pyridinecarbonitriles were metalated with TMPMgCl·LiCl at -30 or -70 °C in one hour and trapped with iodine to give products in 69-85% yield.
The authors rationalize the observed metalation regioselectivity using DFT calculations and attribute the accessible sites to aromatic hydrogen acidity and the inductive effect of fluorine.

在丁酮中，该反应得到54%的10a、可忽略量的10b，以及约5%且未分离的10c。

CF3CH2OTf被列为可给出大于70%收率的活泼电亲试剂之一。

作者开发了醛与α-三氟甲基烷基溴化物的镍/光氧化还原双催化交叉偶联反应。

TEMPO completely suppressed formation of the desired product, and radical-trapping or radical-clock experiments produced trapped products 49 and 50 in reported yields.

Use of (S)-tBu-PHOX gave chiral products with moderate enantioselectivities for examples shown in Scheme 7, although exact values are absent from the extracted text.
氯醌或氟醌与1当量4-叔丁基吡啶在未排除空气湿气的条件下反应，分别得到深红色晶体产物1a和1b。

1-氯蒽醌与DMAP在硝基苯中于135 °C反应92小时，经分离并重结晶后，以45%总收率得到化合物3。

Pyridiniumylanthraquinone 3 showed substantially greater water and thermal stability than the pyridiniumbenzoquinones, with no decomposition observed in boiling water and decomposition beginning only at 255 °C.
Compound 1a exhibited three irreversible reductions, compound 2 lacked the quinone reductions over the reported scan ranges, and compound 3 exhibited two reversible reductions.

The authors explicitly state that their docking comparison may not reliably represent binding conditions because the docking backbone is rigid and a novel ligand is being compared with a prior crystal structure.
The paper reports a three-fragment, C2-selective synthesis of difluoroalkyl-substituted heteroarenes from N-methoxyazinium salts, difluorocarbene, and electrophilic or radical reagents.
The authors propose that an in situ generated difluorinated phosphorus ylide adds to N-methoxyazinium salts and, after methanol elimination, forms alpha-pyridyl-substituted phosphonium salts.
化合物1a与原位生成的叶立德反应时形成了复杂混合物，且未检出预期的鏻盐2a。
N-氧化物1a经三氟甲磺酸甲酯预处理、换用乙腈并加入硅试剂、HMPA和三苯基膦后，在优化条件下以72%收率形成鏻盐2a。
Low temperature was crucial for phosphonium-salt formation; increasing the temperature to 20 degrees C dramatically reduced the yield.

Phosphonium salts 2c and 2e were obtained on gram scale, and their structures were supported by X-ray diffraction analysis; the salts were moisture-sensitive and required storage under inert atmosphere.
The reaction was reported for pyridine, quinoline, and isoquinoline N-oxides with excellent C2 selectivity, and other regioisomers were not detected.
The N-oxide of 2-methylquinoline did not furnish the four-substituted fluoroalkylation product, and Me3SiCF2Br decomposed.
Under basic activation with aldehydes and cesium carbonate in N,N-dimethylacetamide, phosphonium salts 2 afforded alcohol products 4.

In situ formed phosphonium salts gave low yields in attempted photoinduced reactions, whereas isolated salt 2e coupled under blue LED irradiation with a silyl enol ether, a vinyl trifluoroborate, or tert-butyl acrylate under partner-dependent photochemical conditions.
Addition of commonly used Grignard reagents to morpholine 3,3,3-trifluoropropanamide affords (E)-β-fluoro-α,β-unsaturated amides with high stereocontrol.

Morpholine 3,3,3-trifluoropropanamide was prepared quantitatively from morpholine and 3,3,3-trifluoropropanoic acid using EDCI, HOBT, and triethylamine; it was isolated as a stable anhydrous solid that could be weighed in air.
Treatment of reagent 1 with 2 equivalents of phenylmagnesium bromide in 1:1 THF/diethyl ether at −78 °C for 4 hours gave the (E)-fluoroalkene product 2 in 73% isolated yield.

Tolyl, p-chlorophenyl, p-fluorophenyl, p-methoxyphenyl, and naphthyl Grignard reagents afforded the corresponding (E)-products in 50–59% yields; lithium salts improved selected isolated yields during optimization.
Methyl, ethyl, vinyl, and ethynyl Grignard reagents gave only low isolated yields of volatile products: 12%, 10%, 9%, and 11%, respectively.

Isopropyl, cyclohexyl, and butyl Grignard reagents afforded products 8–10 in 62–71% yields with the expected (E)-stereoisomer as the major product; an acetal-containing alkyl reagent gave product 11 in 73% yield, and ortho-substituted and heteroaryl Grignard reagents also reacted.

19F NMR monitoring after addition of one equivalent of isopropylmagnesium chloride detected a β,β-difluoroacrylamide species at −76.0 and −71.2 ppm; addition of the second equivalent produced the (E)-fluoroalkene 8.
Because the proposed enolate was not detected by 19F NMR, the authors suggested that fluoride elimination from that species is instantaneous.
The authors proposed that electronic repulsion between fluorine atoms controls the transition state before elimination and leads to the (E)-fluoroalkene.
Phenyl lithium in the presence of TMEDA produced a ketone assigned exclusively as the (Z)-fluoroalkene in 75% yield; the authors state that TMEDA improved selectivity and yield.
Morpholine amide products 2 and 7 were converted to an amine and a methyl ester, respectively, with complete retention of the (E)-fluoroalkene.
报道了一种多氟烷基四氢萘酮与苯甲脒的串联双环化反应，经多重C(sp3)–F键断裂和四个C–N键形成，在一步中构建两个新环并获得氟烷基化四环[1,3]二氮杂卓。

The preparative reaction conditions use polyfluoroalkyl ketone (0.2 mmol), amidine (0.7 mmol), TBAB (5 equiv), Cs2CO3 (9.5 equiv), 4 Å molecular sieve, and MgSO4 in DMSO at 70 °C for 12 hours under nitrogen.
在所测试的优化条件中，对照实验显示碱金属碱和TBAB均有必要；DABCO和NaOH不如Cs2CO3有效。
At lower Cs2CO3 loading, competing condensation, hydrolysis, decomposition, and self-annulation products were observed; increasing the Cs2CO3 amount suppressed these reactions.

Aryl benzamidines bearing electron-donating or electron-withdrawing substituents gave products in 45-87% yield with high regiocontrol, and OMe, F, Cl, Br, and CF3 substituents were tolerated; a heteroaryl amidine gave product in 45% yield.
An alkyl-substituted amidine was a poor partner, giving 3al in 7% yield, and guanidines furnished different products as the major products rather than the targeted tetracyclic series.
The authors attribute the low yield from the alkyl-substituted amidine to its presumably poor nucleophilic nature.
Substituted alpha-perfluorobutyl tetralones afforded products in 32-90% yield, but ketones derived from cyclohex-2-en-1-one and cyclohexanone gave no desired cyclized products.

Under basic conditions, the starting perfluorobutyl tetralone underwent defluorinative alpha,beta-desaturation to fluoroenone 6 in 82% yield; fluoroenone 6 then afforded product 3aa in 70% yield under the standard conditions, whereas dicarbonyl compound 4b did not.

The authors suggest that fluoroenone 6 may be a key intermediate and propose a sequence involving base-promoted successive defluorination, amidine condensation, intramolecular defluorinative amination, a second amidine condensation, and nucleophilic substitution with further C-F cleavage; an HF-elimination/electrocyclization pathway is offered as an alternative.
The authors propose that TBAB may promote intermolecular condensation and intramolecular C-N bond formation, but state that its detailed mode of action is unresolved.
Difluorodienone 6 was prepared from a phenolic precursor by oxidative dearomatization with PhI(OCOCF3)2 in 68% yield.
The attempted Diels-Alder reaction of difluorodienone 6 with siloxy diene 5 failed under the reported thermal and Lewis-acidic conditions.
Diene 5 was unstable through isomerization even below ambient temperature, and its difficulty adopting the required s-cis geometry was identified as a second cycloaddition limitation.
High-pressure treatment of 6 with diene 18 at 10 kbar in dichloromethane at room temperature for 24 hours, followed by TsOH in methanol, furnished product 14 in reproducible 62-68% yields.
Crude-mixture proton NMR showed that cycloadduct I, rather than product 14, predominated after the high-pressure reaction; HF elimination to 14 occurred only after acid treatment.
Product 14 was formed as an inseparable 3:2 isomer mixture by silica chromatography; preparative separation gave 14a in 40% yield and 14b in 26% yield from a run with 68% combined yield.

Treatment of fluorinated compound 14a with sodium methoxide in methanol from -78 to 0 °C for 15 minutes replaced fluorine with a methoxy group and afforded lactone 20 in 17% yield and ester 21 in 81% yield.
The epimer 14b reacted with sodium methoxide under the same reported temperature and time profile to give ester 22 as the sole product in 85% yield.
Cycloadduct I was extremely acid-sensitive and decomposed during attempted silica-gel purification to product 14 and unidentified products.
Increasing diene 18 to 3.0 equivalents did not cause the double reaction; only product 14 was obtained, in 65% yield.

The paper reports a palladium-catalyzed difluorocarbene transfer reaction involving thermolytic homolysis of an aryldifluoromethylpalladium species and formation of fluorinated products from readily available components.
The optimized catalytic system used Pd[P(t-Bu)3]2, Xantphos, hydroquinone, cyclohexanone, K3PO4, and 1,4-dioxane at 110 °C, affording the model difluoroalkylated arene in 76% yield.
The palladium catalyst, Xantphos, and hydroquinone were each essential under the tested conditions; Pd(dba)2 was a less effective alternative precatalyst.
在所考察的碱中，K3PO4最有效，使C1和M2在6小时内分别以44%和21%收率生成1b和1c；M1未生成1a。作者认为这些结果提示C1和M2可经热均裂产生碳中心自由基。

EPR spin trapping and mass spectrometry supported formation of an aryldifluoromethyl radical from the aryldifluoromethylpalladium complex, including when that complex was generated in situ from ClCF2H, phenyl iodide, and palladium catalyst.
所引范围包括带有甲酰基、酯、腈和酰胺基团的底物；芳基碘化物在多卤代底物中表现出高化学选择性；另有一个芳基溴化物示例生成产物13，但收率略低。

The alkene-partner scope included heteroaryl- and aryl-substituted enones, aliphatic enones, cyclohexenone, linear enones without an alpha substituent, alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehydes, acrylates, and an aliphatic alkene; the aldehydes gave moderate yields and the aliphatic alkene gave a lower yield.
The authors propose that oxidative addition of an aryl iodide occurs before difluorocarbene migratory insertion to form an aryldifluoromethylpalladium intermediate.

Computational comparison found direct 1,2- and 1,4-insertion of the enone into the organopalladium intermediate kinetically unfavorable, whereas homolysis followed by aryldifluoromethyl-radical addition had a substantially lower calculated barrier; the calculated 1,4-addition-derived species was thermodynamically preferred.
The authors interpret deuterium-labeling and computational results as indicating that cyclohexanone acts as a proton shuttle for protonation of a palladium(II) enolate intermediate.
作者报告，通过微调反应条件可高效获得单氟烯烃和脱氧烯化产物；本引文本身未说明这些产物是否由已分离的初级偶联产物后续转化得到，也未建立三氟乙基羰基化合物的选择性单脱氟C–Nu偶联。

The authors report a visible-light photochemical formal [3+2+1] annulation that converts diazocarbonyl compounds into fluorinated nitrogen-containing heterocycles through reactions of fluoroalkyl radicals with α-diazoketones.
所列反应条件为Ir[dF(CF3)ppy]2(dtbpy)PF6（2 mol%）、PPh3、DABCO和DMF，在氮气中于室温接受蓝光照射24–36小时。

Electron-rich, halogen-substituted, bulky naphthyl-substituted, electron-deficient, and 2-thienyl-substituted α-diazoketones furnished fluorinated fused heterocycles, with reported yields spanning 31–78% for the examples described.
Different nitrogen-containing nucleophiles afforded fused heterocycles in 22–57% yield, while 1H-tetrazol-5-amine gave a tetrazole ring-opening product in 34% yield.
九氟碘丁烷在该反应中生成全氟烷基取代杂环5a，收率75%；在随后描述的富电子取代α-重氮酮系列中，相应产物5b–5i的收率为46–82%。
Additional nitrogen-containing nucleophiles gave perfluoroalkylated heterocycles in 42–75% yield, and IC3F7, IC5F11, and IC6F13 gave the desired products in 47–76% yield.

A species assigned as fluoroolefin intermediate II was detected by HRMS after α-diazoketone 1a and pentafluoroiodoethane were reacted for one hour; adding the nitrogen nucleophile and reacting for another 23 hours afforded 4a in 62% yield.
The reaction did not proceed in the dark and gave low yields of 4a when either PPh3 or the photocatalyst was omitted.

The authors propose that a pentafluoroethyl radical adds to the α-diazoketone, the resulting radical intermediate undergoes single-electron reduction, and the resulting fluorocarbon anion undergoes β-fluoride elimination to form fluoroolefin II before cyclization with the nitrogen nucleophile.
报道了一种可见光引发的α-烷基取代乙烯基叠氮化物三氟甲基化/远程脂肪族C(sp3)–H炔基化反应；炔基三氟甲基砜同时作为三氟甲基和炔基供体，生成γ-炔基化三氟甲基酮衍生物。
For the model reaction, 4CzIPN under 40 W blue-light irradiation in MeCN, argon, and room temperature gave product 3aa in 56% isolated yield after 8 hours.

Optimization identified 1,4-dioxane as the best screened solvent, and addition of 0.5 equivalents of Hantzsch ester increased the model-product yield to 78%; conducting the reaction under ambient atmosphere reduced the yield to 36%.
Control experiments gave no product without 4CzIPN or when the reaction was performed in the dark, establishing that both photocatalyst and visible light were required under the tested conditions.
The vinyl-azide scope tolerated Me, OMe, CO2Me, CN, F, Cl, and Br groups; ether, amide, cyclic, and an unactivated C(sp3)-H substrate were reported as successful.
For substrates 1v and 1w, only gamma-alkynylated products were observed, which the authors interpreted as a strong preference for 1,5-HAT over 1,6-HAT.
The reaction was scaled to 2.0 mmol of vinyl azide 1a and afforded 3aa in 70% isolated yield under the reported standard conditions.
在作者报告的合成应用中，3aa与苯硼酸6在Pd(PPh3)2Cl2催化下反应，以54%收率得到含氟α,β-不饱和酮7。

Radical-trapping and radical-clock experiments supported radical involvement in the main visible-light trifluoromethylation/alkynylation: TEMPO completely suppressed 3aa, TEMPO adducts were detected, and beta-pinene gave a ring-opened product in 76% yield.
作者提出一条可能机理：蓝光激发的4CzIPN通过TTEnT促进炔基三氟甲基砜分解并生成CF3自由基；随后经历CF3自由基对乙烯基叠氮化物的加成、1,5-HAT、所得烷基自由基对另一分子炔基三氟甲基砜的加成、β-消除和水解，最终形成产物。
The authors describe an NHC-catalyzed nucleophilic aroylation in which fluorine substituents on fluorobenzenes are replaced by aldehyde-derived aroyl groups to form benzophenones.

The authors planned to prepare benzophenone 4 from 2,4,5-trifluoronitrobenzene 5 and an aldehyde identified in this quotation as 2-fluoro-6-methoxybenzaldehyde 6; treatment in DMF at room temperature with 10 mol% NHC derived from 1,3-dimethylimidazolium iodide 7 produced 4 in 76% yield.

The experimental procedure combined sodium hydride, 1,3-dimethylimidazolium iodide 7, 2,4,5-trifluoronitrobenzene 5, and aldehyde 6 in dehydrated DMF, then stirred the mixture for 10 min at 0 °C and 1 h at room temperature; the supplied excerpt reports a 76% yield for the characterized product, although the product name or number is omitted at that point in the quotation.
The authors propose that a Breslow intermediate is part of the NHC-catalyzed aroylation pathway.
A fluorine substituent of benzophenone 4 was regioselectively replaced by an allyloxy group using potassium carbonate and allyl alcohol at room temperature, affording intermediate 20 in 81% yield.
The remaining fluoro groups of intermediate 12 were replaced by methoxy groups using sodium methoxide in DMF at 80 °C; the experimental procedure reports 25 h and an 89% yield of compound 13.
The remaining fluorine substituents of intermediate 23 were replaced by allyloxy groups using an allyl-alcohol alkoxide in DMF at 60 °C for 3.5 h, giving intermediate 24 in 87% yield.

The authors report that substitution of the remaining fluoro groups by allyloxy groups had to be performed carefully at 30 °C to avoid a competing Claisen rearrangement of the 10a-allyloxy group of 31.
β-Perfluoroalkyl peroxides undergo metal-free, regioselective [3 + 3] annulation with 2-cyanomethyl benzimidazole to form perfluoroalkyl-substituted benzo[4,5]imidazo[1,2-a]pyridines.
The optimized conditions use peroxide 1a, 2.0 equivalents of 2a, 3.0 equivalents of DABCO, and 2-MeTHF at 60 °C in air for 6 h.
在所筛选溶剂中，2-MeTHF表现最优，得到78%的3a及4%的3a′；以TMEDA、DBU、NEt3、吡啶或K2CO3替代所用碱时，结果较差。

Aryl-substituted peroxides bearing electron-donating or electron-withdrawing para or meta substituents furnished products 3a-3i in 62-81% yields; an ortho-bromo substrate gave 3j in 51% yield, which the authors attributed to steric interference.

An aliphatic decyl-substituted peroxide was substantially less effective, giving 3m in 31% yield with about 50% starting material remaining despite elevated temperature and prolonged reaction time; replacing DABCO with tBuOK or NaOH produced no observed 3m or 3m′.
The annulation accommodated naphthalene- and benzofuran-containing peroxides and β,β-difluorinated peroxides bearing ester, amide, or phosphonate functionality.

Changing the benzimidazole partner was possible but could alter regioselectivity: methyl-substituted 2b gave 3s in 68% yield, while 2-ester benzimidazole 2c gave 3t/3t′ in 61% yield as a 1:1 regioisomer mixture.
在缺少2-氰甲基苯并咪唑2a的对照实验中，得到78%的β-氟烯酮4；随后将4与2a置于标准条件下，得到84%的七氟丙基取代环化产物3a。
The authors considered β-fluoro enone 4 very likely to be an intermediate of the transformation.

The proposed mechanism comprises DABCO-mediated peroxide rearrangement and HF elimination to β-fluoro enone B, SNV-type C-F cleavage by the carbanion of 2a to intermediate D, and intramolecular cyclocondensation to product 3.
经硅胶柱色谱纯化后，得到72%的3b（316 mg）和7%的3b′（32 mg）。
该文报道了3,3-二氟氧化吲哚的选择性脱氟烷基化，仅断裂一个C-F键，并生成多种3-烷基-3-氟氧化吲哚。

The general procedure uses 3,3-difluorooxindole, four equivalents of alkene, three equivalents of DMAP-BH3, 1.2 equivalents of NaH2PO4•2H2O, 0.8 equivalents of DTBP, 0.5 equivalents of PhSH, and 1,4-dioxane under nitrogen at 120 °C for 24 h.

Reaction performance depends strongly on the Lewis base-borane complex, additive, and radical initiator: 4-cyanopyridine-BH3 and NHC-BH3 did not promote product formation, water reduced efficiency, KH2PO4 plus water gave only trace product, omission of additive produced a complex reaction, and omission of radical initiator gave no reaction.
The reported alkene scope includes substituted styrenes, an indole-containing alkene, and alkenes derived from (+)-δ-tocopherol and 3-deoxyestradiol.

The 3,3-difluorooxindole scope includes substrates with varied oxindole-ring functionality and N-aryl, N-benzyl, N-methyl, or other N-alkyl substitution; ester, amide, cyanide, alkene, and alkyne groups were reported as tolerated.
Coupling with a simple alkene was unsuccessful; no coupling product formed, 89% of starting 3,3-difluorooxindole was recovered, and some starting material was consumed.
The authors attribute failure with simple alkene 2l to slow addition of radical intermediate II, allowing decomposition of II to predominate and terminate the radical chain.
A radical-clock substrate gave a ring-opened defluorinative coupling product; the authors interpret this result as confirming formation of radical intermediate III.
作者提出的可能机理包括：中间体I经SCS消除氟离子，且C-F键断裂可能受NaH2PO4辅助；所得氟烷基自由基II加成烯烃形成III；III从PhSH获得氢原子生成IV，随后水解形成产物；硫自由基再从DMAP-BH3夺取氢原子，从而再生硼基自由基和PhSH并传播自由基链。
Further defluorination of the monodefluorinated products was not observed.
The authors propose that the high activation energy for DMAP-boryl-radical addition to α-monofluoroamides, attributed to an increased LUMO-SOMO gap, accounts for exclusive monodefluorination.
该论文报道了 gem-二氟烯烃的光催化氢硫化，可获得 α,α-二氟烷基硫醚。

General Procedure D uses gem-difluoroalkene, 10 mol% p-aminoacetophenone, 0.25 mol% iridium photocatalyst, and 1.5 equivalents of thiol in dry MeCN under nitrogen, with 40 W 427 nm irradiation below 30 degrees C for 24 hours.
作者报告该光催化氢硫化可用于脂肪族和苯乙烯基 gem-二氟烯烃，并可使用硫醇和苯硫酚。
Aniline additive increases formation of the difluorinated thioether, while K2CO3 favors the undesired monofluorovinyl thioether and lowers chemoselectivity.
The isolated difluorinated thioether is stable under the reported K2CO3 conditions, excluding it as an intermediate en route to the monofluorovinyl product under those conditions.
作者指出，硫醇盐加成至 gem-二氟烯烃所形成的阴离子中间体可容易地发生 β-氟消除，这是需要克服的竞争过程。
The method tolerates both primary and secondary alkyl thiols in high reported yields, and tertiary thiols react with variable moderate-to-excellent outcomes.
Aqueous conditions support coupling of protected and unprotected cysteine derivatives and glutathione, with reported yields of 75-92% for cysteine products and 90% for the glutathione product.
烷基二氟烯烃通常以约 10:1 的比例形成两种区域异构体；针对富电子硫醇优化后区域选择性大于 20:1；三取代烯烃 30l 的支链:直链比例为 8:5。
Electron-rich thiophenols were sluggish under an earlier catalyst/additive combination, and the yield improvement obtained with m-anisidine at 0.1 mmol did not transfer to 1.0 mmol scale.
The authors speculate that the aniline additive may mediate redox events or act as a PCET co-catalyst and hydrogen-atom donor, but explicitly state that robust mechanistic support is absent.
The authors report a catalyst-free atom-recombination reaction of difluorocarbene with 2-aminoarylketones that produces 3-fluorinated oxindoles.
对于文中称为“tertiary amines”的底物，通法使用底物0.2 mmol、溴二氟乙酸乙酯2.5当量、碳酸钾1.5当量和乙腈1.5 mL，在氩气气氛下于90 °C反应12小时。
对于文中称为“secondary amines”的底物，反应在90 °C进行；初始加入碳酸钾1.0当量和溴二氟乙酸乙酯1.5当量，随后每隔3小时补加相同用量，共补加两次。
Condition screening identified acetonitrile and potassium carbonate as the preferred solvent and base, and increasing the temperature from 70 to 90 °C increased the isolated yield of 3a to 90%.
Alternative difluorocarbene precursors HCF2Cl, TMSCF2Br, and ethyl iododifluoroacetate also reacted, but gave lower yields than ethyl bromodifluoroacetate.

The reported scope includes halogenated, electron-deficient, electron-neutral, aryl, alkyl, methoxy, cyano, nitro, acylamino, acetyl, vinyl, naphthalene, benzothiophene, pyridine, and quinoline-containing 2-aminoarylketones, with the text reporting yields ranging from moderate to excellent depending on substrate class.
Secondary-amine substrates produced the target products in moderate yields, which were lower than those obtained from tertiary-amine substrates.
The authors attribute the lower yields of secondary-amine substrates relative to tertiary-amine substrates to lower nucleophilicity.
Carbonyl-18O labeling was retained in the 3-fluorooxindole product at a labeling rate consistent with the substrate, whereas added H2-18O did not produce an 18O-labeled product.

Conversion of 2-fluoroindole 9 to 3-fluorinated oxindole 3ac under similar conditions is presented as support for a possible epoxide-intermediate rearrangement, but it does not independently establish that intermediate in the principal reaction.

The proposed mechanism involves amine attack on in situ generated difluorocarbene, intramolecular carbon-carbon bond formation with the carbonyl, bromide-mediated substitution, intramolecular cleavage of a neighboring C-F bond to form an epoxide, and rearrangement by a 1,2-fluorine shift; DFT assigns the epoxide-forming substitution a calculated barrier of 23.5 kcal/mol and describes it as rate-limiting.
The review reports that no aerobic biodefluorination of a perfluorinated compound had been demonstrated with solid evidence mapping defluorination products to released fluoride ion.
The authors present alpha-carbon C-H substitution as a hypothesized structural requirement for the initial enzymatic step in aerobic defluorination.
3,3,3-三氟丙酸几乎完全脱氟，而其他所选三碳含氟羧酸的脱氟程度低得多或未发生脱氟；作者认为这可能源于α碳氟取代程度不同。
Formation of FTCA-CoA products by a long-chain acyl-CoA synthetase supports, but does not independently establish, the proposed CoA-initiated beta-oxidation-like defluorination pathway.

For aerobic ether-PFAS biotransformation by activated sludge, the review reports a structural requirement for a neighboring methylene group or a nearby C=C bond and reports spontaneous defluorination of unstable fluoroalcohol intermediates.
在这两个底物的比较中，α碳上的甲基阻碍了2-(三氟甲氧基)丙酸的转化，使其脱氟程度比2-(三氟甲氧基)乙酸低34%，表明该特定比较中的脱氟对α碳甲基取代敏感。

Unsaturated perfluorinated compounds showed no aerobic biotransformation in the cited activated-sludge incubation, whereas unsaturated polyfluorinated carboxylic acids showed structure-dependent biodefluorination.
正文报告2-(三氟甲基)丙烯酸在好氧条件下于24小时内完全去除，并在两周内完全脱氟。

For anaerobic alpha,beta-unsaturated fluorinated carboxylic acids, nearly complete parent removal was reported, suggesting that alpha,beta-unsaturation is important for initiating microbial biotransformation; this initiation interpretation is not direct mechanistic proof.
Anaerobic pathway preference depended on alkene substitution: fluorine substitution at both alpha and beta carbons favored reductive defluorination, while hydrogen substitution favored hydrogenation.

In chlorinated PFAS, hydrolytic dechlorination produced fluoroalcohol moieties that underwent spontaneous HF elimination, and defluorination increased from below 10% for CTFE2 to approximately 80% for CTFE4 as chlorine substitution increased.

The paper reports carbodefluorination of fluoroalkyl ketone-derived N-triftosylhydrazones with beta,gamma-unsaturated alcohols through silver catalysis, forming C-C bonds after selective C-F cleavage.

For phenyl trifluoromethyl ketone N-triftosylhydrazone and indole-3-carbinol, the reported optimized conditions were K2CO3 (2 equivalents), TpBr3Ag (10 mol%), toluene, and 80 degrees C, giving the rearrangement product in 84% yield.
图示通用条件为：1（0.3 mmol，1.0当量）、2a或2b（0.6 mmol，2.0当量）、K2CO3（2.0当量）、TpBr3Ag（10 mol%）、甲苯（4 mL）、80 °C反应16小时；所报收率为分离收率，部分实例按脚注采用修改条件。
作者报告的醇底物范围包括多种杂芳基甲醇，明确列举了苯并呋喃、苯并噻吩、吡咯、呋喃和噻吩甲醇衍生物。

Primary and secondary allyl alcohols were successful partners, with reported products spanning substituted homoallylic alpha,alpha-difluoroketones and yields of 53-94% for the described secondary-alcohol set.
作者报告多种炔丙醇可生成α-CF2联烯产物，并明确证明仲炔丙醇可生成多样的二取代和三取代联烯。
The hydrazone scope extended beyond trifluoromethyl ketones to hydrazones derived from difluoromethyl, difluoropentyl, difluoroketoester, difluorocycloalkyl, and pentafluoroethyl ketones.
For hydrazones derived from alkyl trifluoromethyl ketones, Rh2(esp)2 was reported to be more efficient than TpBr3Ag.

Reaction monitoring showed initial formation of intermediate 209, which reached maximum intensity within one hour and was converted so that product 3 was nearly the sole reaction component by 16 hours.
