该1,2-二取代底物范围考察了不同芳基硼酸，并包括烷基链中含氧连接基及Si–O键的底物；所述产物均显示>99:1的Z/E选择性。另有一组未在引文中明确指明类型的底物，其收率通常低于相应烷基底物，e.r.为80:20至99:1。
模型底物3a顺利生成产物4a，收率为85%，d.r.为97:3。

For the 1,1-disubstituted model reaction, PhBpin and phenylboroxine were comparable to phenylboronic acid, whereas PhBF3K was ineffective; less K3PO4, toluene/water, and temperatures of 50 or 100 °C lowered yield.

The 1,1-disubstituted reaction was limited to styrene derivatives: alkyl-substituted pentafluoroethyl alkenes showed no conversion under standard conditions, and omitting BINAP led to low desired-product yields, incomplete conversion, side products, and poor diastereoselectivity.

Quinoline substitution changed or suppressed stereochemical outcome: the C-3 substrate gave Z product at 96:4 d.r., the C-2 substrate gave E products at 92:8 d.r., and the C-4 substrate underwent essentially no reaction.
3-吡啶基取代的五氟乙基烯烃主要形成并分离得到氢芳基化产物6a–e；相比之下，2-吡啶基底物因转化率低而未形成可报告的氢芳基化产物。

The authors propose a DFT-based catalytic cycle involving arylboronic-acid/Rh(I) transmetalation, alkene coordination, regioselective carborhodation to an alkyl-Rh intermediate, and beta-fluoride elimination to form the Z product.
The DFT calculations found the pathway to the opposite enantiomer higher by 2.17 kcal/mol and the pathway to the E alkene higher by 3.84 kcal/mol.
The reported reaction couples 2,2-difluorovinyl benzoates with arylboronic acids under nickel catalysis to produce gem-difluoroenol ethers.

The desired gem-difluoroenol ether was reported in high yield, and the method reportedly covered 43 examples with broad boronic-acid and difluorovinyl-benzoate scope and excellent functional-group tolerance.
Radical-trapping and radical-probe experiments retained effective product formation and left the cyclopropyl probe unchanged, leading the authors to regard radical-forming pathways as unlikely.
The DFT-supported proposed catalytic sequence is oxidative addition of the vinyl C-O bond, base exchange, transmetalation with the arylboronic acid, and reductive elimination.
The calculated oxidative-addition barrier is about 27.2 kcal/mol, and oxidative addition was identified as the rate-determining step in the modeled reaction.
K2CO3 was calculated to lower the transmetalation barrier by 18.0 kcal/mol, from 37.4 to 19.4 kcal/mol, and to make the overall reaction more exergonic.

The authors interpret base exchange after oxidative addition as weakening the Ar-B bond, promoting aryl transfer to nickel, lowering the transmetalation barrier, and supplying thermodynamic driving force.

The authors report a fluoro-Julia-Kocienski strategy in which controlled C-C or C-S bond cleavage furnishes stereodefined monofluoroalkenes, including (E)-(alpha-fluoro)vinyl sulfones and (Z)-alpha-fluoroenones.

The general procedure uses an alpha-fluoro-sulfonylone, an aldehyde, DBU or Cs2CO3, anhydrous sodium sulfate, and anhydrous acetonitrile at 60-80 °C for 12 hours, followed by chromatographic isolation of monofluoroalkenes.

C-C cleavage with the phenylsulfonyl substrate gives (E)-(alpha-fluoro)vinyl sulfones with E/Z greater than 50:1 across aromatic, aliphatic, heterocyclic, natural-product-derived, and complex aldehydes; reported heterocyclic examples give 70-92% yields and complex examples give 80-95% yields.

The alpha-fluoro-beta-ketosulfone scope includes aromatic, heteroaryl, benzyl, methyl, cyclohexyl, tert-butyl, pivaloyl, and acetyl variants, with electron-deficient phenylacetyl groups described as more reactive.

Changing the sulfonyl substituent to trifluoromethyl switches the reaction to a C-S-cleavage/desulfonation pathway; the reported model product is formed in 89% yield, and additional aldehydes give products in 80-91% yields.
The reaction was demonstrated on gram scale without an appreciable yield decrease; products 3am and 3aq were each isolated in 91% yield at 0.5 g and 0.95 g, respectively.
Olefinic isomerization was observed for aldehydes 2r and 2z, providing the conjugated (1-fluoroallyl)sulfonyl products iso-3ar and 3az.

The authors propose that DBU-mediated deprotonation forms IN1 and aldehyde addition forms oxygen-anion intermediate IN2; for R = CF3, the proposed pathway proceeds through beta-O elimination and loss of trifluoromethylsulfonate, whereas for R = Me it proceeds through benzoyl 1,3-migration followed by olefination.

DFT calculations predict substituent-controlled chemoselectivity and stereoselectivity: for methyl, the C-C-cleavage transition state leading to E product is favored over C-S cleavage; for trifluoromethyl, the C-S-cleavage transition state leading to Z product is favored over C-C cleavage.

Computational comparison predicts a 9.4 kcal/mol lower rate-determining barrier for the fluorinated transition state than for its hydrogen analogue, while experiments with nonfluorinated counterparts show low reactivity/selectivity, including less than 10% conversion with a complicated result or no reaction by NMR and GC-MS.
三氟乙基(芳基)碘鎓盐已被用于通过简单亲核取代和过渡金属催化偶联构建碳-碳键及碳-杂原子键。

Primary and secondary amines, alcohols, carboxylates, thiols, enolates, and enol ethers react with an electrophilic trifluoroethyl iodonium reagent under transition-metal-free conditions; the reported N-, O-, and S-trifluoroethylations occur in dichloromethane at 25 °C and give high yields.
Carbon nucleophiles were reported to be more challenging and less efficient than heteroatom nucleophiles in direct trifluoroethylation with the iodonium reagent.

Tertiary amines, phosphanes, and thioethers form trifluoroethyl onium species, but the dibenzothiophene derivative showed markedly lower reactivity and gave a trifluoroethylsulfonium salt in 31% yield after five days.
在无过渡金属的吲哚 C3 三氟乙基化研究中，先前考察的碱会与吲哚竞争并优先发生 N-烷基化；位阻较大的 2,6-二叔丁基吡啶则可在 DCM、室温下给出目标产物，并报告了 100:1 的化学选择性比。

Palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling of arylboronic acids with trifluoroethyl(mesityl)iodonium salt was highly condition-dependent: Pd2(dba)3/K3PO4 in acetonitrile gave trifluoroethylated products from electron-rich substrates, whereas Pd[P(t-Bu)3]2/Cs2CO3 in DMF gave arylated products from electron-rich or electron-poor substrates.

Water inhibited the trifluoroethylation branch of the arylboronic-acid coupling, molecular sieves improved conversion, and electron-poor boronic acids were not trifluoroethylated under the optimized conditions.

Primary amines added to a trifluoropropenyl iodonium salt to form trifluoromethyl aziridines; sodium carbonate increased the reported yield from 42% to 82%, while a free hydroxy group disturbed the reaction and required prior silylation.
在所考察的胺反应中，位阻更大的胺给出较低收率，而带有 COOMe、CF3 或 NO2 吸电子基的苯胺未观察到产物。

Palladium-catalyzed Z-selective fluoroalkenylation of aromatic compounds used 7.5 mol% Pd(OAc)2, two equivalents of TFA, DCM or DCE, ambient temperature, and 5–24 hours; electron-deficient substrates failed or reacted only at low conversion.

The reported FLP method monoselectively activates a C–F bond of α-trifluoromethylstyrenes and forms γ-substituted α,α-difluoropropenyl phosphonium or pyridinium salts using phosphine or pyridine Lewis-base partners.

The authors describe the reaction as strictly monoselective and report moderate-to-high yields of γ-functionalized pyridinium and phosphonium products that can undergo subsequent α- or γ-functionalization.

For substrate 1a and P(o-Tol)3, ACF gave quantitative conversion at 20 mol% under forcing conditions and 90% and 84% yields at 10 and 5 mol%, respectively; B(C6F5)3 and omission of Lewis acid failed to generate product.
The authors infer that initial Lewis-acid fluoride abstraction through an SN1′ pathway is more likely than an associative SN2′ mechanism.
Single-crystal X-ray structures of 2a and 3a confirm attack by P(o-Tol)3 or TPPy at the vinylic γ-position and formation of difluoro-olefin products.
Aryl-substituted styrene substrates furnished products in reported yields ranging from 97% to 20%, while β-substituted styrenes such as stilbenes failed to produce product.
The authors attribute failure of β-substituted styrenes to sterically hindered access by the Lewis base.

Downstream substitution of pyridinium salt 3a is condition-dependent: chloride gave α-product 4a quantitatively at 60 °C for 16 h but γ-product 5a in 59% at room temperature, and isolated 5a converted to 4a upon heating with chloride.
The authors propose that γ-substituted 5a may be an intermediate en route to α-substituted 4a.
O- or S-donor nucleophiles generated compounds 4e–h at room temperature with no detected γ-intermediates; compound 4h was obtained in 69% yield from 3a and [TBA][BH4].

Aryl groups were installed at either position through Suzuki–Miyaura coupling: a bromide-first palladium-catalyzed sequence afforded α-product 4d in 26%, while nickel-catalyzed coupling of 3a with PhB(OH)2 afforded γ-product 5c in 53%, with related products 5d–f reported in 70–34% yields.
The authors report copper-catalyzed defluoroborylation of 1-(trifluoromethyl)alkenes with B2pin2 to form gem-difluoroallylboronates with high enantiomeric excess.
The reported standard scope conditions use 10 mol% CuI, 11 mol% L5, 2 equivalents each of NaOtBu, B2pin2, and MeOH in CH3CN for 12 hours under argon while warming from 0 °C to room temperature.
Control experiments showed that omitting either MeOH or NaOtBu dramatically reduced product yield, and FeCl2 did not support the reaction under the tested conditions.
The reaction tolerated ether, fluoride, chloride, bromide, iodide, ester, cyano, sulfide, and amino functional groups; the quotation additionally reports an OCR-rendered “indoyl” group.
For substrates containing multiple potentially reactive C-F sites, the reaction strongly favored activation at the vinyl-fluoro functionality over the terminal alkyl-fluoro position.
Substrates bearing strongly coordinating amine, sulfide, or O-phthalimide moieties still underwent defluoroborylation in good yields under the reported conditions.

The reaction showed substrate-dependent limitations: a secondary-alkyl-substituted trifluoropropene gave low conversion and a diastereomer mixture, while beta-(hetero)aryl substrates produced only small amounts of alpha-boronate addition products.
Precursor gem-difluoroallylboronate 3a was unstable on silica gel and was isolated in 58% yield, compared with 84% isolated yield for product 4a.
An independently generated 1:1 CuI:L5 complex was characterized, but it was not a competent catalyst and was therefore excluded as the true catalyst under the tested conditions.

The authors propose formation of an active copper species, transmetalation with an anionic B2pin2 adduct, enantioselective organocopper-intermediate formation, and cis beta-fluoride elimination to release product and a CuF-like species; this catalytic sequence is proposed rather than directly established.

HP(O)Ph2, water, and Cs2CO3 in DMSO at 125 °C for 12 h selectively hydrodefluorinated the model polyfluoroarene, giving 93% NMR yield and 90% isolated yield without other regioisomers or multiple-hydrodefluorination products.

Solvent, base, H−P(O) reagent identity, water, and reaction time materially affected model-reaction performance; DMSO and Cs2CO3 outperformed the tested alternatives, and triphenylphosphine oxide lacking an H−P bond produced no product.

The reported scope includes polyfluoroarenes bearing electron-donating or electron-withdrawing groups, several heteroarenes, amide, thioether, and ether substituents, with moderate-to-good yields; perfluorotoluene underwent aryl C(sp2)−F hydrodefluorination while its C(sp3)−F bonds remained intact.
Simple monofluoroarenes represented by 3-fluorobenzonitrile and 1-fluoro-4-methoxybenzene failed to react.
Under the standard conditions, 2,2,2-trifluoro-1-phenylethan-1-one degraded while forming a monodefluorinated product and an undefined fluoride species.
在所测试的当前体系中，未观察到化合物46b−46f所考察的C−O、C−N或C−C键、杂环48的C(sp2)−S键以及酮50−51的C(sp2)−Br/Cl键发生反应。
对于单苯硫基底物46a，C−S相关重构与HDF产物形成并存：产物3的NMR收率为39%，重构产物47a的NMR收率为24%、分离收率为20%。
作者提出假说：所讨论的转化可能通过涉及游离硫醇盐的竞争性SNAr路径进行。

NMR monitoring detected a signal assigned by the authors to F−P(O)Ph2 after 1 min, and water accelerated reaction rate and product formation; direct defluorinative phosphorylation remained below 5% NMR yield in the condition survey.
The authors suggest that water promotes H−P(O)-to-P−OH tautomerization and that this tautomerization may be the key rate-determining step.
作者提出一种可能的路径：多氟芳烃1a的C(sp2)−F键向P(III)−OH物种2a′氧化加成形成中间体G，随后经质子转移形成HDF产物；DFT计算给出的TS1和产物形成TS2势垒分别为37.5和25.8 kcal/mol。
A chiral diene-rhodium catalyst couples 1-(trifluoromethyl)alkenes with arylboroxines to form chiral 1,1-difluoroalkenes in high yields and at least 95% ee.
For substrate 1a and arylboroxine 2a, [RhCl(cod)]2, 2.2 equivalents of KOH, and dioxane/water at 35 °C for 16 hours afforded 3aa in 85% yield, together with 8% terminal alkene 4 and 6% recovered 1a.
Base-free conditions gave very slow reaction and mostly recovered substrate, whereas adding KOH substantially accelerated arylation and increasing the amount of KOH generally increased conversion.
The (R,R)-Fc-tfb ligand gave 3aa in 92% yield and 99% ee, with alkene 4 and diarylation product 7 as minor products; ligand identity strongly affected activity and product selectivity.

Under the reported (R,R)-Fc-tfb conditions, trifluoromethylalkenes bearing phthalimino, secondary amino, tertiary amino, ester, or hydroxyl groups gave the target products in high yields and 95–99% ee; the reaction also furnished chiral allylsilane 3ha with high ee.

Arylboroxines bearing alkoxy, methyl, bromo, or trifluoromethyl substituents at the 3- or 4-position of phenyl were successfully incorporated in high yields, while a bulky aryl group gave a slightly lower yield.

An aryl-substituted trifluoromethylalkene performed poorly under the arylboroxine conditions, giving 9% arylation/defluorination product and 3% hydroarylation product; raising the temperature improved yields only partially and did not provide high product selectivity.
Replacing phenylboroxine in aqueous dioxane with PhZnCl in THF restored selective defluorination of the aryl-substituted alkene, affording 3ic in 85% yield and 99% ee at room temperature.
The authors propose that arylrhodation generates a beta,beta,beta-trifluoroalkylrhodium intermediate, which then undergoes beta-fluoride elimination to form the difluoroalkene.

Beta-fluoride elimination and beta-hydrogen elimination compete from the alkyl-rhodium intermediate, and the product distribution is highly sensitive to ligand, base, solvent, and other reaction conditions.

In a subsequent cross-coupling of the isolated difluoroalkene products, Grignard reagents gave disubstitution products with a nickel/dppp catalyst, while the authors report that palladium catalysts did not effect this cross-coupling.
Peroxide-initiated hydrophosphinylation of gem-difluoroalkenes forms α,α-difluorophosphine oxides while avoiding C–F substitution.
The initial model reaction used gem-difluorostyrene, diphenylphosphine oxide, 0.5 equivalents of di-tert-butyl peroxide, tert-butanol, 120 °C, and 16 hours, affording product in 82% yield.

Unless otherwise stated, the quoted scope conditions used 1a (1.0 mmol), phosphorus reagent 2 (3.0 mmol), di-tert-butyl peroxide (0.05 mmol), DMF or tert-butanol, and a nitrogen atmosphere for 24–26 hours; the quoted general procedure specifies 120 °C.

Reducing di-tert-butyl peroxide to 5 mol% improved the model reaction, whereas larger peroxide quantities caused nonproductive conversion; three equivalents of diphenylphosphine oxide gave quantitative yield, while four equivalents lowered the yield.
DMF and tert-butanol were the best-performing solvents in the model system, while butyronitrile and nitromethane produced no product under the tested conditions.

The gem-difluoroalkene scope included electron-rich and electron-deficient difluorostyrenes, halogenated substrates, heterocyclic substrates, and two alkyl-derived gem-difluoroalkenes, with reported yields spanning 56–96% across the summarized examples and complete regioselectivity for the two alkyl-derived examples.

Alkyl-trisubstituted gem-difluoroalkenes gave only trace product, and nitro-containing gem-difluoroalkenes were not tolerated because fluoride-elimination processes occurred both with and without peroxide.

The quoted diarylphosphines bearing electron-donating or electron-withdrawing substituents delivered α,α-difluorophosphine oxide products in 73–84% yield; ethyl phenyl phosphinate gave 29%, and di-n-pentylphosphine oxide gave 50%.
Diethyl phosphite was an unsuccessful phosphorus partner, giving only trace product despite further optimization of time, solvent, temperature, and peroxide.
The authors report detecting acetone as a stoichiometric byproduct by GCMS in standard reactions.

The authors propose a free-radical chain mechanism in which a methyl radical abstracts hydrogen from diphenylphosphine oxide, the resulting phosphorus-centered radical adds regioselectively at the difluorinated alkene carbon, and the carbon-centered radical abstracts hydrogen from another equivalent of diphenylphosphine oxide to form product and propagate the chain.
β,β-Difluoro-α-trifluoromethylstyrene derivatives reacted with three equivalents of sodium methoxide in acetonitrile at 25 °C to afford α-trifluoromethylated arylacetates in good yields.

Alkoxide stoichiometry controlled the product distribution: one equivalent of sodium methoxide gave monosubstituted product 2a in 87% yield, two equivalents gave 2a and ester 3a in 40% and 41% yields, and three equivalents gave 3a in 75% yield.
作者报告少量产物4a和5a的收率分别为5%和3%；使用6当量甲醇钠时，仅形成丙二酸酯5a，收率79%。

Primary alkoxides such as ethoxide and propoxide behaved similarly, whereas three equivalents of sodium tert-butoxide produced only the monosubstituted fluorinated vinyl ether in 62% yield and no α-trifluoromethylated arylacetate.
Styrene derivatives bearing a variety of benzene-ring substituents afforded α-trifluoromethylated arylacetates in good yields with three equivalents of sodium alkoxide.
在3a的制备中，作者在氩气下将氢化钠加入甲醇的干燥乙腈溶液并于室温搅拌30分钟；随后在−15 °C滴加底物，保持30分钟后升至室温。
以己烷/乙酸乙酯（9:1）洗脱后，作者获得了methyl 2-phenyl-3,3,3-trifluoropropanoate（3a，0.168 g），报告收率为77%。

The authors propose that methoxide attack gives monosubstituted product 2a through addition and β-defluorination, after which dealkylation and another defluorination form ketene 6a; further methoxide reaction and aqueous quench then afford ester 3a.
Ketene 6a was not directly isolated, although a large amount of methyl ether was detected by GC-MS.
作者认为，GC-MS检测到大量甲醚，以及1a与3当量叔丁醇钠的反应结果，可能支持所提出的脱烷基路径；作者同时报告未能直接分离6a。
The authors report a copper(I)/Josiphos-catalyzed enantioselective γ-boryl substitution of CF3-substituted alkenes with a diboron compound to produce optically active gem-difluoroallylboronates.
For (E)-1a, CuCl/(R,S)-L1, bis(pinacolato)diboron, NaOMe, and THF at 30 °C afforded (R)-2a in 91% yield and 97% ee.
Reducing NaOMe to 10 mol% caused the boryl substitution to proceed only scarcely, establishing a strong base-loading dependence under the tested conditions.
Conducting the reaction at 0 °C slightly decreased the yield to 84%, while the enantioselectivity remained 97% ee.
Using the (Z)-configured substrate instead of (E)-1a under the optimized conditions gave significantly lower enantioselectivity, showing that alkene geometry affects stereochemical outcome.
Alkenes bearing hexyl or methylcyclohexyl groups gave products in 89-90% yield and 96-97% ee; a more sterically congested branched alkene still gave 88% yield but only 50% ee.
The tetra-substituted gem-difluoroallylboronate (R)-2e was not formed, defining an explicit failed substrate example.
The authors propose steric hindrance as the probable reason that tetra-substituted product (R)-2e was not formed.

A chloro-substituted alkene reacted without detected side products, and substrates containing phthalimide or secondary or tertiary amino groups furnished target compounds in 61-89% yield and 95-97% ee.
The boryl substitution was demonstrated on a 5.0 mmol scale, affording (R)-2a in 88% yield and 97% ee.

The authors anticipated that the present transformation could proceed through a mechanism analogous to asymmetric allylic boryl substitution, involving enantioselective addition of a borylcopper intermediate followed by elimination; this mechanism was proposed rather than directly established on the supplied pages.
The authors report defluorinative C-S cross-coupling of gem-difluoroalkenes with sodium sulfinates to form α-fluoro-β-arylalkenyl sulfones under transition-metal- and base-free conditions.
在所引实验中，偕二氟烯烃与3当量苯亚磺酸钠在脱气DMSO中、氮气下于100 °C反应24小时，3aa以82%分离收率获得，E/Z大于99:1。

A variety of sodium sulfinates underwent the reaction in moderate to good yields with excellent stereoselectivity, and sodium alkylsulfinates gave products 3ao-av in 75-97% yields with excellent E/Z selectivity.
The gem-difluoroalkene scope included substituted gem-difluorostyrenes, polycyclic aromatic substrates, and several heteroaryl substrates.
Ortho substitution was associated with poor yield, and the authors attributed this outcome to steric hindrance.
Electron-rich sodium sulfinates showed greater relative reactivity than electron-deficient substrates in a competition experiment, supporting a nucleophilic substitution interpretation.
Electronic repulsion was associated with reduced stereoselectivity for products 3oo and 3qb, which were reported at E/Z ratios of 9:1 and 7:1, respectively.
Addition of TEMPO, BHT, or 1,1-diphenylethylene did not obviously inhibit the reaction; the authors interpreted this result as ruling out a radical process.

The authors propose nucleophilic addition of a sulfinate-derived anion to the gem-difluoroalkene, followed by preferential anti-β-fluoride elimination from a favored conformational model to produce the E-selective product.
The reaction was demonstrated on a 4.0 mmol scale, affording 1.02 g of product 3ab in 78% yield under the standard DMSO, nitrogen, 100 °C, 24-hour conditions.
所引实验段落报告产物5c、5d和5e的分离收率分别为65%、45%和71%。

Fluoroolefin-mediated deoxygenative substitution of nonactivated and activated alcohols with acidic nucleophiles constructs C−S, C−N, C−O, and C−Se bonds with inversion of configuration through an O-tethered monofluoroalkene intermediate.

The optimized model reaction used fluoroolefin activator 2c and t-BuOLi in DMSO, with alcohol activation at 60 °C for 12 h followed by thiol addition and heating at 100 °C for 24 h under nitrogen; product 4a was isolated in 92% yield and 99% ee.
Both base and fluoroolefin activator were required: no reaction occurred when either component was omitted.
The authors suggest that performance differences among t-BuOLi, t-BuONa, and t-BuOK may arise from differences in basicity and C−F···M+ interactions.
DMSO was the preferred solvent; DMF gave 83% yield and 99% ee, MeCN gave 18% yield, and dioxane and xylene gave no product under the compared conditions.

The demonstrated nucleophile scope includes arylthiols with varied electronics and substitution patterns, heteroaryl thiols, an alkylthiol, amines, carboxylic acids, and phenylselenol, enabling C−S, C−N, C−O, and C−Se bond formation.
Benzoic acid and phthalimide showed poor conversion with (R)-4-phenylbutan-2-ol and did not provide isolatable corresponding products, with reported yields below 5%.
For nucleophiles containing multiple nucleophilic sites, the reaction distinguished S, O, and N sites, and products arising from other nucleophilic sites were not detected.
The alcohol scope included primary nonactivated and activated allylic alcohols and multiple secondary alcohols, including acyclic, cyclic, chiral, and sterically hindered examples.

Isolated O-tethered monofluoroalkenes 7 and 9 reacted with thiol 3a to produce thioether 4a in 89% and 96% yield, respectively, with 99% ee, directly supporting their competence as substitution intermediates.
The authors propose that defluorinative reaction of the alcohol with the fluoroolefin forms O-tethered monofluoroalkene A, followed by SN2 substitution with inversion of configuration.

The authors developed a magnesium-mediated reductive defluorinative cross-electrophile coupling of α-trifluoromethyl styrenes with carbon-centered electrophiles, producing gem-difluoroallyl carboxylic acids and ketones.
在所引模型羧化实验中，α-三氟甲基苯乙烯底物与4当量镁粉、8当量TMSCl在DMF中反应，条目1给出71%的核磁收率和67%的分离收率。
Magnesium and TMSCl were both required under the tested conditions; zinc or indium substitution gave no detected product, and changing solvent from DMF reduced or eliminated yield.
作者报告在25 °C进行该反应时，收率下降并伴随更多副产物形成。

The carboxylation tolerated multiple aryl substituents, including fluoro, chloro, methyl, methoxy, trifluoromethyl, trifluoromethoxy, methylthio, tert-butyl, trimethylsilyl, fused-ring, heterocyclic, and heteroatom-substituted examples; electron-donating substituents generally gave higher yields than electron-withdrawing substituents.
作者报告，含酯基或氰基的受试底物未检测到目标产物，芳环含溴底物只检测到还原脱溴产物；该方法未被用于α-三氟甲基脂肪族烯烃的脱氟羧化。
The authors suggest that strongly electron-withdrawing substituents suppress product formation by decreasing the nucleophilicity of an anionic intermediate.

Both alkanoyl and aroyl imidazoles served as electrophiles under conditions reported as identical to the CO2 reaction, furnishing gem-difluoroallyl ketones; formyl imidazole furnished a gem-difluoroallyl aldehyde.
A 7.0 mmol reductive defluorinative carboxylation was reported to proceed without a significant decrease in yield.
Detection of a 15% self-coupling product led the authors to suggest the possible presence of a gem-difluoroallyl radical intermediate.

The authors propose sequential single-electron reduction of the α-trifluoromethyl alkene, fluoride loss to a gem-difluoroallyl radical, a second electron transfer to a gem-difluoroallyl anion, and nucleophilic attack of that anion on the electrophile.
The dissertation reports a palladium-catalyzed defluorinative coupling of 1-aryl-2,2-difluoroalkenes with boronic acids that affords monofluoroalkenes with high diastereoselectivity.

The optimized defluorinative coupling employed palladium(II) trifluoroacetate, 4,4'-di-tert-butyl-2,2'-bipyridine, DMF, and 50 °C; the quoted general procedure used 11 mol% ligand and two equivalents of arylboronic acid.

All reported scope cases formed monofluoroalkenes with a diastereomeric ratio of at least 50:1; substituted aryl difluoroalkenes and arylboronic acids tolerated multiple functional groups and ortho, meta, and para substitution, while some heteroaryl difluoroalkenes required longer times or higher temperature.
The reaction was suited to boronic acids and potassium tetrafluoroborate salts; boronic esters reacted sluggishly, and arylstannanes and arylsilanes were inert both with and without added fluoride.

The reaction was highly selective for mono-coupling, but substrate/product 3m showed over-reaction side products; lowering the boronic acid loading remedied this issue and allowed isolation in moderate yield.
A difluoroacrylate mechanistic probe produced both a defluorocoupled product and a 1,4-conjugate-addition product, as identified in the crude mixture by proton and fluorine NMR spectroscopy.

The authors interpret formation of the conjugate-addition product from the difluoroacrylate as support for a pathway involving palladium-alkyl formation by migratory insertion followed by beta-fluoride elimination.
When 1,1-difluoro-1,2-diphenylethane was subjected to the standard conditions, the corresponding monofluoroalkene was not observed.
The authors interpret the negative saturated-substrate control as suggesting that beta-fluoride elimination is not simply base-mediated and instead occurs from a palladium-alkyl intermediate.
The paper reports mechanochemical defluorinative acylation of ortho-hydroxyarylenaminones with CF3 compounds in the presence of Yb2O3 to produce 3-acylchromones.
Optimized conditions used 1.3 equivalents of CF3 substrate, 1 equivalent of Yb2O3, 4 equivalents of NaHCO3, and 0.3 equivalents of DABCO, with milling at 30 Hz for 90 minutes at room temperature.
The optimized model reaction furnished compound 3f in 91% isolated yield.

DABCO and the identity of the bicarbonate base strongly affected reaction efficiency: alternative organic bases lowered the yield, while replacing NaHCO3 with KHCO3 gave 39% rather than 91% yield under the tabulated conditions.
The reported scope comprised 26 3-acylchromones and included products bearing aromatic, heteroaromatic, and aliphatic moieties.

Halodifluoromethyl substrates RCF2X (X = Cl, Br, I) were also used as acylating reagents, and four corresponding 3-acylchromones were reported without a significant yield change relative to the CF3 analogues.
Under the established conditions, aliphatic C-F bond activation was favored over aromatic C-F bond activation in substrates containing other fluoro groups.
A control experiment starting from chromone 10 did not form 3-acylchromone 3f upon reaction with 1-fluoro-4-(trifluoromethyl)benzene 2i.
Under the reported operational conditions, 1,3-difluoro-5-(trifluoromethyl)benzene 2m underwent complete defluorination, and the corresponding acid 13 was isolated in good yield.

The authors propose that chemoselective activation of the CF3 group by ytterbia in the presence of DABCO forms a carbon-centered *CF2- radical, which attacks the enaminone; the resulting radical intermediate is then proposed to undergo oxidation to a carbocation followed by pyrone-ring formation.

The authors also propose an alternative pathway involving an acyl fluoride formed by partial hydrolysis of the CF3 group, followed by nucleophilic attack of the enaminone beta-carbon, sequential defluorination, cyclization, deprotonation, and beta-elimination.

Titanocene difluoride and diphenylsilane catalyze the hydrodefluorination of hexafluoropropene at room temperature, producing two pentafluoropropene stereoisomers in 47% and 32% yield, with only trace amounts of a regioisomer and a second hydrodefluorination product.
The hexafluoropropene reaction slightly favors one pentafluoropropene stereoisomer; only traces of a regioisomer and a second hydrodefluorination product were detected.
Neither 1,1,3,3,3-pentafluoropropene nor more than trace quantities of tetrafluoropropenes were observed, even with prolonged reaction time.

The hexafluoropropene hydrodefluorination reached turnover frequencies of 508 h-1 in 0.5 M solution and 1570 h-1 at higher concentration, remained active at -25 °C with a turnover frequency of 5 h-1, and achieved up to 125 turnovers.

Titanocene difluoride/diphenylsilane hydrodefluorination of tetrafluoroallene showed low efficiency: turnover numbers remained below three, elevated temperature promoted rapid substrate dimerization, and the system was judged unsuitable for that substrate.
作者提出一种可能解释：若反应遵循β-氢化物插入/β-氟消除路径，插入可产生20a或20b；20a可经β-氟消除并继续催化循环，而缺少β-氟取代基的20b不能重返循环，因此插入步骤的区域选择性可能决定催化效率。
The proposed off-cycle tetrafluoroallene insertion side product was not successfully isolated.
在所述低温NMR研究中，没有发现插入产物9的证据，反应混合物中仅检测到化合物1、4和6的共振。
作者认为该结果提示此处可能存在一条复分解路径。

Lithium aluminum hydride reacted unselectively with tetrafluoroallene even without zirconium fluoride, giving a complex mixture of fluoroallenes; boron hydrides were also reactive toward the substrate.

Poly(methylhydrosiloxane) had nearly no effect in the attempted zirconium-catalyzed hydrodefluorination of tetrafluoroallene, giving 9% product and a turnover number of 1.5 after 87 hours at room temperature.
Titanocene difluoride was reported as a precatalyst for catalytic C-F activation and hydrodefluorination of several fluoroalkenes using silanes as the hydrogen source.

Hydrodefluorination of 1,1,3,3,3-pentafluoropropene 29 with diphenylsilane and catalytic 18 gave tetrafluoropropenes, with the E isomer 28b formed at 90% selectivity and a turnover frequency of 201 h-1.
Hydrodefluorination of 3,3,3-trifluoropropene was slow and competed with hydrogenation, producing difluoro- and monofluoropropenes as well as trifluoropropane and propane.
作者提出，生成丙烷48的氢化副反应似乎会不可逆地毒化催化剂18，其依据是48相对于18呈化学计量产率。

Sequential hydrodefluorination can outpace initial substrate consumption: for trifluoroethene, the second and third hydrodefluorination steps were reported to be faster than the first, leading to ethene and ethane before complete consumption of starting material.

For hexafluorocyclobutene, the degree of hydrodefluorination depended on silane loading: 0.6 equivalents favored pentafluorocyclobutenes, 1.2 equivalents favored tetrafluorocyclobutenes, and higher ratios predominantly formed trifluorocyclobutene with additional more-defluorinated and unidentified products.
六氟丁-2-炔61被报道可快速生成结构未知的红色聚合物；同一引文还报告一个未在片段中明确命名的底物以低转化率形成复杂的氢脱氟产物混合物。

Catalytic activity depended strongly on catalyst ligand electronics, silane substitution, and donor solvent: simple titanium fluorides were inactive, tertiary silanes failed to activate the catalyst, and catalytic hydrodefluorination with 18 proceeded only in donor solvents such as THF or diglyme.

Independent titanium-hydride experiments support titanium hydride involvement: isolated complex 63 catalyzed hydrodefluorination at nearly the same turnover frequency as precatalyst 18, and independently prepared titanocene(III) hydride 19 rapidly converted two equivalents of substrate to hydrodefluorination products and titanocene(III) fluoride 21.

The proposed catalytic cycle uses a titanium hydride to transfer hydride to the fluoroalkene, forming hydrodefluorination products and titanocene(III) fluoride, which is proposed to regenerate the hydride by reaction with excess silane.
作者总结认为，插入/β-氟消除和σ键复分解两种机制均可在氟代烯烃催化氢脱氟中起作用；低温NMR未能观察到所提出的中间体65a/b。作者还提出前一途径可能解释E/Z选择性，而对至少部分环状烯烃，后一途径更快但并非总是可行。
化合物25具有所报告的X射线衍射晶体数据：晶系为单斜晶系，空间群为P21/c，且对于I > 2σ(I)的反射，最终R1 = 0.0285。
所引原子坐标表明确列出了化合物25晶体学模型中的1个铬原子、4个氟原子和3个氧原子。
Compound 25 contains a C1-C2 linkage reported as 1.330(2) Å and a C1-F1 linkage reported as 1.3717(16) Å.
作者报告了tris[bis(η5-cyclopentadienyl)-µ2-fluoro)titanium]（21）的晶体结构及其分子结构和编号方案。
The crystal data for compound 21 give empirical formula C50H70F3Ti3O5, an orthorhombic P212121 crystal system, and final R1 = 0.0713 for reflections with I > 2σ(I).
Compound 21 has six reported Ti-F contacts, with two fluorine contacts associated with each titanium center and distances ranging from 2.052(4) to 2.064(3) Å.
The abbreviation list defines A/E as an addition/β-fluoride-elimination mechanism and HDF as hydrodefluorination.

Formate was used as a precursor of the carbon dioxide radical anion in a photoinduced defluorocarboxylation of alpha-trifluoromethylstyrene, furnishing gem-difluorovinylacetic acids without a metal catalyst.
The optimized model reaction gave product 2 in 85% yield using potassium formate, 4DPAIPN, thiol HAT catalyst T1, DBU, DMSO, blue LEDs, an argon atmosphere, and a temperature of 30 °C for 2 hours.

Photocatalyst and solvent choice strongly affected feasibility: an iridium photocatalyst gave 8% yield, 4CzIPN gave no isolated desired product, and THF, acetone, and acetonitrile failed to give product 2.
Control experiments found that the photocatalyst, HAT reagent, base, and light were each essential for the desired reaction.

Aryl-substituted alpha-trifluoromethylstyrenes bearing ether, aryl chloride, aryl bromide, trimethylsilyl, thioether, and trifluoromethoxy groups afforded the corresponding gem-difluorovinylacetic acids in 70–88% yields.
The reported scope tolerated an unprotected amino group, naphthalene, several heteroaryl groups, and derivatives of natural products and drug molecules.
On a 5.0 mmol scale, gem-difluorovinylacetic acid 2 was isolated in 73% yield under the standard conditions.
TEMPO completely suppressed the model reaction under standard conditions, which the authors interpreted as evidence suggesting a radical intermediate.
When 1,1-diphenylethylene was used to scavenge the carbon dioxide radical anion, addition product 29 was detected.

The authors propose a radical/polar crossover mechanism in which a thiyl radical generates the carbon dioxide radical anion from formate, radical addition to the alpha-trifluoromethylstyrene forms a benzyl radical, single-electron reduction forms a benzyl anion, and beta-fluoride elimination gives the product.

On the basis of reported reduction potentials, the authors consider direct one-electron reduction of the trifluoromethyl alkene by the carbon dioxide radical anion, followed by reaction with carbon dioxide, to be basically excluded.
作者报道了一系列氟代芳烃的氢脱氟和氨基脱氟反应，这些反应在温和条件下取得良好至很好的收率。
底物1与Ph2Si(Cl)(NEt2)在10 mol % PnBu3存在下于60 °C反应18 h，得到氨基化产物12，收率75%，并剩余10%的底物1。

The aminodefluorination of pentafluoropyridine was not fully selective: an additional fluorinated product was observed in 10% abundance, together with a phosphonium species that was the major phosphorus-containing species.
底物1与Ph2Si(Cl)(pro)反应，其中pro为L-脯氨酸甲酯，得到产物13，收率88%；产物的1H NMR表征与脯氨酸甲酯部分得到保留相符。

Pentafluorobenzonitrile and perfluorotoluene also underwent PnBu3-catalyzed aminodefluorination with Ph2Si(Cl)(NEt2), furnishing products 14 and 15 in 82% and 50% yield, respectively; these substrates were more sluggish than under the hydrodefluorination conditions.
PnBu3与Ph2SiH2的组合被作者确定为最优；底物1在20 °C反应20 min后以93%收率生成HDF产物2，且在这些条件下未观察到其他HDF区域异构体或多次HDF产物。
五氟苯甲醚在该体系中仅表现出很低的HDF反应性；溴五氟苯在20 °C反应20 min时未生成HDF产物9，作者提出氢脱溴似乎比HDF更有利。
催化反应中观察到一个被归属为[(C5F4N)PnBu3]+的鏻离子；其光谱归属由独立制备的溴盐支持。底物1完全消耗后该信号消失并重新观察到游离膦，作者据此提出该鏻物种可能是催化静息态。

The independently prepared phosphonium bromide did not react with Ph2SiH2 alone, but addition of fluoride produced hydrodefluorinated product within 10 minutes and product increased as the phosphonium species decreased.

The authors propose a catalytic sequence involving initial fluorophosphorane formation by phosphine addition to the fluoroarene, fluoride abstraction by silane to form a phosphonium hydrosilicate ion pair, hydride transfer, and product elimination that regenerates phosphine.

DFT calculations support an asynchronous, Meisenheimer-like phosphine addition and C−F activation pathway for pentafluoropyridine, with a calculated 55 kJ mol−1 barrier; the authors characterize the step as formal P(III)-to-P(V) oxidative addition.

The reported transformation is a transition-metal-free defluorinative cycloaddition of gem-difluoroalkenes with organic azides in morpholine, producing morpholine-substituted, fully decorated 1,2,3-triazoles.

The optimized reaction used gem-difluoroalkene, 1.5 equivalents of 4-azidobenzonitrile, morpholine as solvent at 0.4 M, 0.4 equivalents of LiHMDS, 75 °C, and 48 hours, affording product 3a in 70% yield.
A transition-metal catalyst was unnecessary: the catalyst-free reaction gave 31% yield at 50 °C and 70% yield after increasing the temperature to 75 °C.
Organic azide thermal decomposition to anilines was the only observed byproduct class and reduced isolated yield; no other byproducts were detected by TLC or crude 1H NMR.

The gem-difluoroalkene scope included para electron-donating methyl, tert-butyl, and methoxy substituents in 40–70% yield, a para-cyano substituent in 52% yield, and a bulky naphthalene group in 57% yield.
Electron-withdrawing aryl-azide substituents reacted faster than electron-donating substituents; benzyl azides were less reactive and required 110 °C for 72 hours.
Replacing morpholine with piperidine or azepane reduced yields to 30–42%; in the piperidine reaction, extensive azide decomposition and incomplete conversion accompanied the modest yield.
19F NMR监测在反应30分钟内观察到被作者指认为INT-1的物种；其1H NMR中的3JH–F = 35.7 Hz以及19F NMR中匹配的耦合常数支持作者对INT-1之Z构型的指认。
A 2D NOESY experiment supported the assigned 1,5-disubstituted triazole regiochemistry and placement of morpholine at C-4.

The authors propose initial base-mediated nucleophilic addition–elimination of morpholine to form INT-1, followed either by an aminoalkyne cycloaddition pathway or by vinylic azide substitution, cyclization, and aromatization.
The authors attribute the superior LiHMDS result primarily to miscibility and propose direct deprotonation of morpholine, while explicitly retaining scavenger-base behavior as an alternative.
所引反应采用Ni(COD)2、4-甲氧基吡啶、Ph2SiH2、K2CO3和THF，在60 °C反应16 h；收率以CH2Br2为内标通过NMR测定。
The optimized coupling was completely linear-selective in the reported experiments: only linear product was observed, with no branched product.
在所测试条件下，省略Ph2SiH2未形成产物且原料保持不变；以Et3SiH替代Ph2SiH2时仅得到痕量目标偶联产物，并观察到烯烃氢化。
温度筛选中，20 °C、40 °C和80 °C分别得到4%、59%和45%的收率。
带乙氧基、十二烷氧基、环丙基甲氧基或环戊基甲氧基取代的gem-二氟烯烃生成产物3–6，收率为57–85%；多种苄氧基取代的gem-二氟烯烃生成相应gem-二氟烯醇醚7–12，收率为66–72%。

Both (E)- and (Z)-directed internal alkenes gave the same product in 82% and 71% yields, and several longer, substituted, cycloalkyl-containing, and primary-chloroalkyl substrates also coupled in 63–75% yields.
The reaction showed a significant hydrogenation side reaction for N-(pent-4-enyl)picolinimide: coupled product was obtained in 52% yield together with nearly 40% N-pentylpicolinamide.
Replacing the picolinamide auxiliary with benzamide prevented the desired coupling; a 44% linear hydrosilylation product was detected and most of the difluorovinyl benzoate decomposed.

Tether length strongly affected coupling: N-propylpicolinamide gave no difluorovinyl-coupled product, N-butenyl- and N-pentenylpicolinamides gave 85% and 52%, and N-hexylpicolinamide lacked reactivity.
对该反应混合物的HRMS分析显示m/z 463.0974的特征分子离子簇；作者基于质量值和同位素分布将其归属为乙烯基Ni(II)配合物Ni–A。将反应时间延长至16 h后，以45%收率形成交叉偶联产物3。
在所述两项自由基捕获剂实验中，产物3分别以82%和72%收率形成，未见显著抑制；作者认为这一结果与涉及碳自由基的机制不一致。
该转化是三氟甲基取代烯烃与脂肪醛的镍催化脱氟偶联，生成含偕二氟烯结构单元的高烯丙醇。
The coupling extrudes a single fluorine atom from the trifluoromethyl-substituted alkene and furnishes a 1,1-difluoroalkene product.
优化条件使用NiCl2(DME)、6,6'-二取代联吡啶配体L1、LiCl、1,5-己二烯、TESCl和作为牺牲还原剂的纳米锌，以83%分离收率得到3a。
Nickel, ligand L1, nanopowder zinc, and 1,5-hexadiene were each important to productive coupling in the control experiments.
Olefin additives reduced formation of enol ether and silyl ether side products, with 1,5-hexadiene outperforming the other tested olefin additives.
The ligand framework strongly affected yield: 6,6'-dimethyl-2,2'-bipyridine L1 was optimal, while BiOx, Terpy, PCy3, and IMes gave lower yields.
The aldehyde scope included unhindered, beta-branched, and alpha-branched aliphatic aldehydes, although branched substrates reacted with diminished efficiency.
For a substrate containing both aldehyde and ketone groups, coupling was completely selective for the aldehyde and left the ketone unchanged.

Electron-rich and electron-deficient 1,1-trifluoromethylstyrenes reacted under mild, base-free conditions in 71-93% yield, and several ester, amide, sulfonyl, nitrile, sulfide, and heterocyclic functionalities were compatible.

An alkyl-substituted trifluoromethyl alkene was a poor coupling partner: most starting alkene was recovered, enol ether and reduced silyl ether side products formed competitively, and only 6% desired product was detected by GC-MS.
作者基于底物1q的行为提出：表格2和3所述还原偶联最可能涉及I、II和IV等有机镍中间体，而非酮基自由基直接向三氟甲基烯烃加成；这是一项机制推测，并非直接确证。
该工作报道了无导向基的镍氢催化氟代烯烃氢烷基化，并实现氟代烯烃与仲烷基卤化物的对映及非对映选择性偶联，以获得含氟邻位立体中心。
所列反应条件为 NiCl2·DME（10 mol%）、L8（15 mol%）、甲基二乙氧基硅烷、KF，以及 1:1 的 DMA/t-BuOH，在 0 °C 下反应 40 h。
Under the optimized conditions, product 3aa was obtained in 88% isolated yield, 99% ee, and 96:4 dr.
报道的底物范围包括带烷基氯、保护胺、醇、邻苯二甲酰亚胺或呋喃的氟代烯烃；其他可行底物含溴、碘、酮、酯、砜、吲哚、Bpin，以及伯酰胺或叔酰胺官能团。
在粗反应混合物中检测到了明显量的非生产性 C-F 断裂产物。
作者预期氢脱氟和烷基镍中间体的 β-氟消除会构成反应设计挑战，并假设由于氟和氢尺寸相近，C-F 碳上的立体诱导也会较困难。
Attempts to conduct the same hydroalkylation with a cobalt catalyst failed.
The reaction displays a strong fluoroalkene stereochemical boundary: (Z)-1a reacts without observed isomerization, whereas (E)-1a is largely unreactive and pure (E)-1a gives no 3aa.
TEMPO suppressed formation of the coupled product and produced an alkyl-TEMPO adduct, while a cyclopropyl radical-clock substrate gave ring-opened products.
Deuterium labeling gave almost quantitative deuterium incorporation exclusively beta to fluorine, and the isolated product was a single diastereoisomer without detected deuterium scrambling.

The proposed mechanism invokes single-electron activation of the alkyl halide, formation of a Ni-H species, enantioselective hydrometalation of the fluoroalkene to a Ni(II) alpha-fluoroalkyl complex, radical capture, and reductive elimination from Ni(III).
在所述反应条件下，加入 K3PO4 后产物 3 的收率提高至 86%；同时观察到相对于 C-F 键数量计 83% 的 PhMe2SiF。
减少 K3PO4 至 1 当量使产物 3 的收率下降 32%，并伴随生成 35% 的硅烷 5；无碱时烃 3 的收率下降并观察到产物 2；减少硅烷、缩短反应时间或降低温度时也均观察到不可忽略量的 2。
某底物在初始测试中仅有约 30% 转化；在 120 °C 下，底物 7 完全转化但只检测到少量完全氢脱氟产物 9，而底物 8 与 18 当量氢硅烷反应时也只得到少量彻底氢脱氟产物 10。
周期取样分析显示，化合物 2 和 5 起初形成并最终被消耗，而化合物 3 和 4 的浓度持续增加。
作者认为该结果提示化合物 2 和 5 是生成产物 3 的反应中间体。
在所考察的前一反应阶段，去除 K3PO4 未影响反应速率；相比之下，无碱时化合物 2 的转化率仅为 27%，作者据此认为 K3PO4 在 2 的高苄位氢脱氟中起关键作用。
The reaction rate increased with ICy at Ni/ICy ratios below 2 but decreased when more than two equivalents of ICy were present relative to nickel, showing inhibition by excess ligand.
化合物 2 在所述 60 °C 加热实验后保持不变；在 Ni(cod)2 和 ICy 存在下进行消除反应时观察到 η2-配合物 13，其结构由 NMR 光谱和 X 射线晶体学确定；无 K3PO4 时未观察到 13。
The authors suggest that Ni/ICy promotes K3PO4-mediated HF elimination, but state that the reason for this promotion remains unclear.

For conversion of the proposed difluoroalkene intermediate, the authors consider two possible nickel pathways: direct oxidative addition of a vinylic C-F bond, or Ni-H insertion followed by beta-fluorine elimination; both pathways are proposed to pass through a monofluoroalkene before further defluorination.

The authors report palladium-catalyzed coupling of gem-difluorinated cyclopropanes with boronic acids to form arylated, alkenylated, and alkylated 2-fluoroallylic products, with good functional-group compatibility and high Z-selectivity.

The reported standard conditions use gem-difluorinated cyclopropane, 1.5 equivalents of the boronic acid, 10 mol% Pd(OTFA)2, 15 mol% PtBu3·HBF4, one equivalent of Cs2CO3, and CH3CN at 80 °C under argon; the optimized model reaction gave 90% assay yield, 85% isolated yield, and 38:1 Z/E.

In the reported optimization, KF did not promote the reaction, the tested Pd(II) catalysts were described as more efficient than the tested Pd(0) catalyst, lowering the temperature to 60 °C gave 45% of 3a, and no reaction occurred when both ligand and palladium catalyst were omitted.

The arylboronic-acid scope included electron-rich, electron-poor, ortho-, meta-, and para-substituted partners and tolerated CF3, CN, aryl chloride, ether, ester, ketone, amine, ketal, and thianthrenyl functionality; the amine-containing substrate furnished only the C-C-coupled product, with no amination product observed.

The gem-difluorinated-cyclopropane scope included aryl substrates bearing neutral, donating, and withdrawing substituents, a pyridine-containing substrate, an alkenyl-substituted substrate that formed a conjugated fluorodiene, and an estrone-derived substrate that gave product in 73% isolated yield.

Alkenylboronic acid gave only trace product under the original optimized conditions but coupled successfully after changing to Pd-G3 and Q-Phos; methylboronic acid also coupled under modified conditions to give product in 72% isolated yield with high Z/E selectivity.
A gram-scale reaction furnished 2.87 g of product 3i in 94% isolated yield, and the resulting 2-fluoroallylic product underwent hydrogenation to an alkylation product.
Competition experiments showed coupling at the gem-difluorinated cyclopropane while analogous gem-dichlorinated cyclopropane and cyclopropylbenzene competitors did not react.

The authors propose a catalytic pathway involving Pd(0)-mediated C-C bond activation of the gem-difluorinated cyclopropane, beta-fluoride elimination to an active complex, transmetalation with the boronic acid, and C-C bond-forming elimination that releases the Z-major product and regenerates Pd(0).

The introduction identifies a previously reported palladium-catalyzed C-C activation/C-F cleavage of gem-difluorinated cyclopropanes with N- and O-centered nucleophiles, but the supplied text does not provide its structures, conditions, yields, or scope.
The authors report nickel-catalyzed selective C(sp2)-F bond alkylation of HFO-1234yf with alkylzinc reagents.

Initial Ni(cod)2/bipyridine conditions in THF at room temperature gave only trace product; MeCN raised the yield to 19%, whereas dioxane, DMF, CH2Cl2, and toluene gave less than 2%, and defluorination remained significant.
吡啶-噁唑啉配体 L4 使反应以 78% 收率进行，并显著抑制脱氟副反应；PCy3 和 PPh3 几乎使该反应停止。
No product was obtained without LiCl/MgCl2, whereas product was obtained without MgCl2 when LiCl was present; no product was observed without nickel.

Primary alkylzinc reagents gave moderate to good yields, and the reaction tolerated silylether, benzyloxy, arylether, ester, phosphate, acetyl, amide, acetal, pyrrole, alkyl borate, and aryl bromide functionality.
Secondary alkylzinc reagents gave lower yields, while arylzinc and alkenylzinc reagents showed poor compatibility because over-defluorination products formed.
Attempts to substitute HFO-1234yf directly with Grignard or organolithium carbon nucleophiles did not provide the desired products.

Stoichiometric experiments detected an L2-supported alkenylnickel complex, independently generated the same species from a vinyl bromide precursor, and found that LiBr was required for its formation from the eta2 nickel complex.
Kinetic studies found that N-based ligand L2 supported a higher observed oxidative-addition rate than PMe3, while PPh3 showed no oxidative-addition activity.
络合物 B3 与所述烷基锌试剂反应时未生成 3a；络合物 B4 与 2a 或 2a' 反应时分别以 8% 和 23% 收率生成 3a。

The authors propose a Ni(0)/Ni(II) cycle involving HFO coordination, lithium-assisted selective C(sp2)-F oxidative addition to an alkenylnickel(II) species, transmetallation, and reductive elimination.

The authors demonstrated organophotoredox gem-difluoroallylation of acyclic and cyclic ketone derivatives, activated as dihydroquinazolinones, with alpha-trifluoromethyl alkenes to furnish gem-difluoroalkenes.
