Under the benchmark Suzuki–Miyaura regimes, homocoupling, protodebromination, and protodeborylation were not observed, although monoarylation and diarylation products were formed.

In the Kumada coupling, n-Oct4NBr switched selectivity toward C4, but high C4 selectivity required both the salt additive and an appropriate low-phosphine Pd/P ratio; a Pd(OAc)2/4PPh3 system remained C2-selective even with the salt.

With Pd(PPh3)4, direct reaction with 2,4-dibromopyridine predominantly formed the C2 oxidative-addition regioisomer at 23 °C, and the major regioisomer was characterized by X-ray diffraction and NMR spectroscopy.

The authors hypothesize that quaternary-ammonium salts electrosterically stabilize in situ formed Pd nanoparticles and that these nanoparticles cause the atypical C4 selectivity and enhanced activity.

For Pd3-cluster or nanoparticle catalysis, the authors propose organoboron activation before aryl-halide activation, potentially through a Pd3-hydroxo species or a boronate complex activated at a nanoparticle surface; they explicitly state that the mechanistic model requires independent investigation.

The authors report direct electrochemical oxidative coupling of thiols and amines without an additional catalyst or sacrificial reagent; the flow transformation can be completed in 5 minutes and produces hydrogen at the counter electrode.

Acid identity and concentration, electrolyte loading, and anode material affect reaction performance: omitting or reducing acid lowered isolated yields, sulfuric acid was slightly inferior to hydrochloric acid, higher electrolyte concentration lowered yields, and other anode materials were less efficient.

Batch operation was possible but required 24 hours and increased electrolyte loading, while flow was used in most cases for optimal yields; batch processing was useful when longer reaction times or insoluble starting materials were involved.

Kinetic experiments showed complete conversion of the thiol to the corresponding disulfide within the first 20 seconds; disulfides were competent coupling partners, and the disulfide was consumed within 5 minutes as sulfonamide formed.
TEMPO or 1,1-diphenylethylene completely suppressed sulfonamide formation, and radical adducts were detected by GC-MS, supporting generation of aminium radical intermediates.

The authors report an electrochemical synthesis of sulfonyl fluorides from thiols or disulfides and KF without an additional oxidant or catalyst.

The reported preparative conditions use thiol or disulfide, 5 equivalents of KF, 1 equivalent of pyridine, a 1:1 acetonitrile/1 M HCl medium, a carbon anode, an iron cathode, and electrolysis at 20 mA; the scale-up used 3.2 V applied potential.
The optimized representative reaction gave the targeted sulfonyl fluoride in 74% isolated yield using KF, pyridine, a biphasic acetonitrile/1 M HCl medium, and graphite/stainless-steel electrodes.
Tetra-n-butylammonium fluoride, NaF, and CsF were less effective than KF under the investigated conditions.
Omission of acid or use of lower acid concentrations decreased yields.
Pyridine was beneficial, and the authors proposed that it may act as an electron mediator or phase-transfer catalyst.

Kinetic experiments showed rapid anodic conversion of 4-(trifluoromethyl)thiophenol to the corresponding disulfide within 45 minutes, followed by consumption of the disulfide and formation of sulfonyl fluoride.

A 1-fluoro-pyridinium reagent produced only traces of product, whereas KF combined with either HCl-pyridine or HCl-Et3N gave sulfonyl fluoride in good yields; the authors interpreted this as evidence for nucleophilic fluorination.
Radical scavengers reduced process efficacy, which the authors interpreted as supporting radical intermediates.
The authors tentatively assigned observed fluorinated species as sulfenyl fluoride and sulfinyl fluoride intermediates; these species were not isolated.

The demonstrated scope includes electron-neutral, electron-donating, and electron-withdrawing thiophenols, as well as primary and secondary aliphatic thiols; reported yields for these groups ranged from 37–99% and 19–96%, respectively.

Palladium and copper co-catalyze chloro-arylation of gem-difluorostyrenes with aryl sulfonyl chlorides, producing fluorine-retentive difluorinated products rather than monofluorinated β-fluoride-elimination products.

Early reaction development produced mixtures of desired chloro-arylation product, β-fluoride-elimination products, and a chloro-sulfonylation product; substrate electronics affected the side-product distribution.

Nitrite was uniquely effective among screened additives at favoring chloro-arylated product over the monofluoroalkene formed by β-fluoride elimination; the effect depended on the nitrite/nitrate anion rather than sodium.
Increasing NaNO2 from 0 to 1.0 equivalent systematically increased product selectivity from 1.3:1 to 11:1, and 1.0 equivalent was selected for further studies.
Pd(OAc)2 and copper powder were the best-performing catalyst combination in the reported catalyst-system studies, and routine optimization identified 130 °C in 1,4-dioxane for 3 hours as optimal.

The preparative scope conditions used gem-difluorostyrene, two equivalents of aryl sulfonyl chloride, 2.5 mol% Pd(OAc)2, 10 mol% copper powder, 25 mol% NaNO2, and 1,4-dioxane at 130 °C for 3 hours under nitrogen.
The reaction tolerated electron-rich and electron-deficient gem-difluorostyrenes, halogenated substrates, and substrates containing N-benzenesulfonyl indole or benzofuran moieties.
Non-styrenyl gem-difluoroalkenes and gem-difluoroalkenes containing N–H groups or thioethers were not tolerated.

Across the gem-difluorostyrene scope, chloro-arylated-product selectivity was generally greater than 9:1, and NaNO2 held β-fluoride-elimination product B to an average yield at or below 4%, apart from reported outliers.
Aryl sulfonyl bromides were incompatible and predominantly produced aryl bromides.

The authors propose that nitrite binding to a putative Pd(Cl)(alkyl) intermediate may either block the coordination geometry needed for β-fluoride elimination or accelerate C–Cl reductive elimination through a nitrite π-back-bonding effect.

The optimized standard conditions use Pd(TFA)2, 4,4'-di-tert-butyl-2,2'-bipyridine, DMF, and 50 °C, with 10 mol% palladium and 11 mol% ligand.

All reported monofluorostilbene products were formed with a diastereomeric ratio of at least 50:1.

The difluoroalkene scope tolerated alkyl, ester, nitro, trifluoromethyl, ether, and halogen substituents, while boronic-acid partners tolerated halogen, ester, methoxy, trifluoromethoxy, trimethylsilyl, free-alcohol, and protected-amine substituents.
部分杂芳烃取代的二氟烯烃在延长反应时间和/或升高温度的条件下具有兼容性；所报告的特殊条件包括反应5天以及在85 °C反应4天。

The reaction was generally selective for monocoupled products, but substrate/product 3m produced over-coupled side products; lowering boronic-acid loading to near-stoichiometric quantities remedied this behavior and gave 3m in moderate yield.

The conditions were suited to boronic acids and potassium tetrafluoroborate salts, whereas boronic esters reacted sluggishly and arylstannanes and arylsilanes were inert both with and without added fluoride.
A difluoroacrylate mechanistic probe gave a mixture of defluorocoupled product 6 and 1,4-conjugate-addition product 7.
When 1,1-difluoro-1,2-diphenylethane 8 was subjected to standard conditions, monofluoroalkene 9 was not observed.

The authors propose migratory insertion of the difluoroalkene into a palladium-aryl bond to form an alkylpalladium intermediate, followed by beta-fluoride elimination and transmetalation with an aryl boronic acid; they further interpret the probe results as favoring beta-fluoride elimination from a palladium alkyl intermediate rather than simple base-mediated elimination.

Across six C(sp2)–C(sp2) Ni-catalyzed Suzuki–Miyaura substrate pairings, optimal precatalyst performance varied substantially; monophosphine precatalysts tended to outperform bisphosphines for electronically deactivated and sterically hindered substrates.
No single Ni precatalyst was optimal for every substrate pairing, and the same precatalyst could give very low yield in one reaction and nearly quantitative yield in another.

The authors interpret the inverse ligand order in oxidative addition as evidence that ligand dissociation precedes oxidative addition and implicates a P1Ni species.
DFT calculations found a lower monoligated oxidative-addition barrier for CyTyrannoPhos, whereas dcypf and dppf had lower barriers along their bisligated pathways.
在所述实验中，最快的产物形成速率出现在χ = 0.5，对应于周转限制步骤中的1:1单膦/Ni化学计量比。

With 2-thiophenylboronic acid, added thiophene or increased boronic-acid loading decreased the yield of the monophosphine system, whereas added 2-phenylthiophene product had no effect and the bisphosphine systems were unaffected by these additives.

The authors propose that thiophene formed by protodeboronation deactivates the more labile monophosphine system, while P2Ni-favoring bisphosphines protect the catalyst; direct quantification of thiophene and discrimination between catalyst-mediated and base-catalyzed formation were unsuccessful.

The incompatibility of the monophosphine catalyst was substrate-specific rather than general to all thiophene or furan partners: 2-chlorothiophene, 3-thiophenylboronic acid, and 2-furanylboronic acid gave reported yields of 90%, 80%, and 98%, respectively.
N-Benzoyl-2-methyl aziridine and phenyl iodide underwent Ti/Ni cross-electrophile coupling under the reported standard conditions to give an 81% yield and 12:1 branched-to-linear product ratio.

Control experiments established that omission of Ni and ligand prevented C-C coupling and produced reductive ring-opened products, while omission of Ti gave only 32% aziridine conversion and trace cross-coupled product.
The authors interpret the optimization controls as suggesting that Ni is responsible for C-C bond formation and Ti is responsible for aziridine activation.

Among the Ti catalysts screened, Cp*TiCl3 and CpTiCl3 afforded cross-coupled product with preferential branched selectivity, whereas the quoted Lewis-acid and alternative-Ti conditions gave either trace product or low-yield mixtures of isomers.

The additive screen identified broad functional-group boundaries, including tolerance of boronic esters and anilines, potential problems with aryl ketones, aryl bromides, and silyl ethers, and incompatibility with alkynes, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, nitro groups, several alkyl halides, aliphatic amines, and alcohols.

Electron-rich and electron-deficient aryl iodides, several singly ortho-substituted aryl iodides, and pyridyl or quinolyl iodides coupled successfully, but all three tested di-ortho-substituted aryl iodides gave 0% yield.

With the exception of 8a, the reported aziridine-scope reactions gave 80–90% yields with branched selectivity; increasing alkyl-substituent size decreased branched selectivity, and 8b gave exclusively linear product in low yield. Apart from cyclic aziridines, the tested di- and tri-alkyl-substituted aziridines did not undergo cross-coupling under the reported conditions.
A radical-clock aziridine underwent sequential cyclizations to give the cyclized product in 30% yield, supporting involvement of an alkyl-radical pathway.

TiIII-mediated reductive ring-opening produced both branched and linear ring-opened products, and changing to a larger alkyl substituent gave a similar ratio, indicating that radical ring-opening itself is feasible for both regioisomers and does not explain the substrate-size selectivity trend.

Stoichiometric and NMR experiments detected a hydrophosphination intermediate; heating to 70 °C converted it to the mono-HDF product and fluorinated phosphorus species, supporting stepwise hydride addition followed by beta-fluoride elimination.

The authors propose a catalytic sequence in which diazaphospholene hydride transfer forms hydrophosphination intermediate A, beta-fluoride elimination gives mono-HDF product 3 and 1-F, PhSiH3 regenerates the catalyst, and a second HDF gives monofluoroalkene 4.
所引计算能量剖面报告：第一次氢负离子转移、第一次β-F消除和第二次氢负离子转移的Gibbs活化能分别为18.9、20.7和24.0 kcal mol−1；作者将两次氢负离子转移势垒的5.1 kcal mol−1差异解释为单次与双次HDF化学选择性的原因。
作者报告实验E/Z比为85/15，并称β-F消除步骤的Gibbs活化能与这一实验结果吻合。
The authors report a catalyst-free defluorinative carbosilylation of alkenes using silyl boronates and fluorinated compounds bearing an inert C(sp2)-F or C(sp3)-F bond.
The general procedure uses organic fluoride (1.0 equiv), silyl boronate (2.0 equiv), alkene (2.0 equiv), KOtBu (4.0 equiv), and cyclohexane/THF (8:1) at room temperature for 2.5 hours under nitrogen.
In the reported optimization experiments, replacing KOtBu with NaOtBu gave 4aa in 15% yield, while no desired product was obtained without base or with LiOtBu, KOMe, or KHMDS.
Nickel is unnecessary under the optimized conditions: omission of Ni(COD)2 furnished the model product in 94% NMR yield and 91% isolated yield, similar to the nickel-containing reaction.

Both primary and secondary alkyl fluorides underwent regioselective defluorinative alkylsilylation of styrenes; reported yields were up to 94% for primary fluorides and 36-52% for the two secondary fluorides.

Alkene scope has explicit boundaries: aryl and conjugated alkenes react, non-aryl alkenes are unreactive, electron-deficient acrylates and acrylamides are unsuitable, and the tested internal styrenes did not react.
The reaction tolerated ether, CF3, and chloro substituents, and the tested CF3 groups remained intact rather than undergoing C-F activation.

Changing the fluoride electrophile to chloride, bromide, or iodide did not provide the analogous targeted three-component alkylation product under identical conditions; an alkyl chloride instead gave a two-component alkene-silyl product in 22% yield.

The experiments support the authors' proposal that radical species are involved: TEMPO significantly inhibited the model reaction, and another experiment gave a silylated ring-opened product as the major product in 55% yield, while the expected three-component product was detected only in trace quantity by GCMS.

The authors propose a KOtBu-triggered single-electron-transfer radical cascade in which a silyl radical adds to the alkene, potassium and a borate species assist C-F activation, and C-C bond formation generates the three-component product together with KF.
Observed side reactions included disilane formation and double styrene addition, attributed by the authors to silyl-radical dimerization and overreaction of a benzyl radical with styrene.

A catalytic o-phosphinophenolate/thiol HAT system effected monoselective defluoroalkylation of N-phenyltrifluoroacetamide with alkenes under 427 nm irradiation; under the reported optimal conditions, the desired product was obtained in 90% NMR yield with 5% of byproduct 4.

The general trifluoroacetamide defluoroalkylation procedure used trifluoroacetamide, 1.5 equivalents of alkene, 10 mol% PO1, 30 mol% Cs2CO3, 20 mol% 1-adamantanethiol, and 2 equivalents of potassium formate in anhydrous DMA under argon, with 427 nm irradiation at room temperature for 24 hours.

The authors propose that photoexcited PO− reduces the trifluoromethyl substrate to a difluoromethyl radical, which either undergoes hydrogen-donor reduction or alkene capture; the resulting alkyl radical is then proposed to be reduced through thiol HAT catalysis, with formate-derived CO2 radical anion participating in catalyst turnover.

The reported spectra identify PO1− as the visible-light-absorbing species in the reaction mixture; its excited-state reduction potential was estimated as −2.89 V versus SCE, and no bathochromic shift consistent with formation of an electron-donor-acceptor complex with amide 1 was observed.

Control experiments showed that PO1, 1-adamantanethiol, and light were essential for the reported reactivity; omission of formate still gave product 3 in 18% yield, whereas exposure to air completely suppressed catalytic reactivity and resulted in recovery of starting materials.
A measured quantum yield of 4.4 led the authors to suggest that formate-derived CO2 radical anion may also activate trifluoromethyl substrates in relay with the thiol HAT catalyst.

Trifluoroacetamide substitution strongly affected feasibility and selectivity: electron-neutral or electron-rich N-aryl substrates mainly gave monodefluoroalkylation products with 5–10% hydrodefluorination, strongly electron-deficient N-aryl substrates mainly gave didefluoroalkylation, an N-aryl substituent was essential, and tertiary amides were not applicable.
The reaction accepted multiple aliphatic, internal, cyclic, allylic, and vinyl alkene classes, but styrene- and acrylate-type substrates were unsuitable.
The electrophile scope extended beyond trifluoroacetamides to trifluoroacetates and trifluoromethyl (hetero)arenes, although trifluoromethylbenzene itself showed less than 15% conversion.

Monoselectivity was condition- and substrate-dependent: increasing alkene loading suppressed hydrodefluorination, cesium formate loading was critical for hydrodefluorination monoselectivity, and a para-ester-substituted N-phenyltrifluoroacetamide underwent complete hydrodefluorination.
该文报道了一种卡宾引发的重排策略，用于氟烷基酮与β,γ-不饱和醇的碳脱氟反应，生成结构和官能团多样的α-单氟及α,α-二氟-γ,δ-不饱和酮。

An optimized indole-carbinol reaction used phenyl trifluoromethyl ketone N-triftosylhydrazone, indole-3-carbinol, K2CO3 (2 equivalents), and TpBr3Ag (10 mol%) in toluene at 80 °C, affording the rearrangement product in 84% yield.

For allyl and propargyl alcohols, the general procedure used N-triftosylhydrazone, TpBr3Ag (10 mol%), K2CO3 (2 equivalents), and two equivalents of alcohol in DCE at 80 °C; the stated reaction times were 12 h for allyl alcohols and 18 h for propargyl alcohols.
The demonstrated alcohol scope includes heteroaryl carbinols, allyl alcohols, and propargyl alcohols, giving diverse fluorinated unsaturated ketones.
Tertiary alcohols were not suitable for the transformation.
The authors propose that steric hindrance during electrophilic attack may explain the failure of tertiary alcohols.
作者报告，烷基三氟甲基酮衍生的N-triftosylhydrazones在所述条件下不是合适底物，因为会发生竞争性1,2-氢迁移并形成烯烃。
对于烷基三氟甲基酮衍生的N-triftosylhydrazones所参与的文中反应，作者观察到Rh2(esp)2比TpBr3Ag具有更高效率。

Reaction monitoring by 1H NMR showed initial formation of intermediate 209, which reached maximum intensity within one hour and was subsequently converted to product 3, the near-sole reaction component by 16 h.
Isolated intermediate 209 gave product 3 in 91% yield under the reaction conditions and in 64% yield without silver catalyst.
Pre-prepared ether 210 failed to produce rearrangement product 44 under the standard conditions, excluding the tested O-H carbene-insertion ether pathway.

The general two-component procedure uses a trifluoromethylarene, 1.5–2.0 equivalents of propellane, 5 equivalents of γ-terpinene, 10 mol% PCN or PBN photocatalyst, 1.2 equivalents of Cs2CO3 or CsOH·H2O, degassed DMSO, and 427 nm irradiation for 12 hours at room temperature.
The optimized carbazole-based PCN photocatalyst furnished the desired product in 74% yield and was reported to have an excited-state reduction potential of −3.26 V versus SCE in DMSO.
在该反应的催化剂比较中，PCN(2)和PBN(3)分别给出55%和48%产率，苯基保护的PBN(4)给出12%，而diMe-PBN及不含邻位PPh2取代的BN在所测条件下无效。
Control experiments established that photocatalyst, base, and visible light were each essential under the tested conditions, while omission of γ-terpinene caused poor reaction performance.

Propellane dimerization is an observed competing pathway: an ArCF2–diBCP side product was detected, and increasing propellane to 3 or 5 equivalents significantly decreased efficiency through unproductive dimer formation.

The authors propose photoexcitation of an N-anionic catalyst followed by single-electron reduction of the trifluoromethylarene, formation of a difluorobenzylic radical, addition to propellane, hydrogen-atom transfer from γ-terpinene, and catalyst regeneration by a final single-electron transfer.

The reaction accommodated trifluoromethylarenes with electron-donating or electron-withdrawing substituents and tolerated amides, ethers, esters, anilines, alkenes, alkynes, alkyl chlorides, aryl boronates, unprotected amines, and alcohols.
全氟烷基芳烃可与[1.1.1]propellane发生选择性脱氟偶联并以61%产率得到产物；对于所测试的双(三氟甲基)苯，作者报告仅活化一个C–F键，产率为32–71%。
The strain-release coupling extends beyond [1.1.1]propellane to [3.1.1] and [4.1.1] systems, affording ArCF2–BCH products in 35–80% yield and ArCF2–BCO products in 21–62% yield.

The paper cites a prior report titled “Construction of C–X (X = S, O, Se) bonds via Lewis acid-promoted functionalization of trifluoromethylarenes”; the supplied text provides no reaction conditions, scope, yields, selectivity, or mechanistic evidence for that report.

The authors report copper-catalyzed, switchable defluoroborylation and hydrodefluorination of trifluoromethylated alkynes that affords four types of CF2-containing compounds; solvent and ligand quantity control diborylation versus monoborylation, while the base controls formation of gem-difluoroalkenes versus difluoromethylalkenes.
Condition A produced the sp2/sp3 diborylated product in 82% yield using CuSCN and 1,10-phenanthroline at 10 mol% each, MeOLi, water, THF, 60 °C, and a four-hour reaction time.
在该模型反应的条件筛选中，使用t-BuOK或DBU以及增加MeOLi用量均促进了额外脱硼产物4和5的形成，使二硼化产物3难以专一生成；作者据此认为碱的强度和用量对该体系的产物化学选择性具有重要影响。
在所述二硼化研究中，芳香族底物上的烷基、硫醚、氯和苯基取代基，以及稠环、苯并噻吩、4,4-二甲基硫色满和含N-H键的酰胺均可获得相应产物；脂肪族三氟甲基炔烃则在改变反应条件后也可得到二硼化产物。
Alkyl-substituted trifluoromethyl alkynes predominantly formed a hydroboration by-product under Condition B; monoborylated products were obtained only after adjustment of the reaction conditions.
在1a的模型反应中，作者以Condition C为基础采用一锅两步操作，并额外加入5当量t-BuOK，从而以65%产率得到二氟甲基化产物68；该方案被定义为Condition D。
在所述中间体投料实验中，只有化合物102能够高产率生成产物3、4和5；作者据此推断化合物103和104不是这些转化的中间体。

Time-course monitoring under Condition B showed that compound 102 and diborylated product 3 rose initially and then declined while monoborylated product 4 increased, supporting sequential conversion of 102 to 3 and then chemoselective hydrodeborylation to 4.

Control experiments showed that stoichiometric phenanthroline enhanced selective benzyl-boronate deborylation of compound 3, while MeOLi increased hydrodeborylation efficiency; the combined additives operated even without CuSCN.
Deuterium-labeling experiments gave 80-95% deuterium incorporation under Conditions A-D, supporting water as the proton source in the reported defluoroborylation and hydrodefluorination processes.

The authors propose that a cuprous boryl species adds regioselectively to the alkyne, protonation forms intermediate 102, and secondary borylation followed by beta-fluoride elimination gives the Condition A product; subsequent ligand-, base-, and temperature-dependent deborylation steps account for Conditions B-D.

The authors report a NiH-catalyzed ipso- and migratory defluorinative cross-coupling of olefins with gem-difluoroalkenes under mild conditions, producing structurally diverse monofluoroalkenes bearing a tertiary allylic stereogenic center.
Optimization identified NiI2·xH2O, chiral BOX ligand L1*, and DEMS as an effective catalyst system, affording the model product in 83% isolated yield and 92% ee.

The reported general procedure uses 10 mol% NiI2·xH2O, 12 mol% L1*, 1 equivalent KI, 6 mol% TBAF, DMA, 1.5 equivalents of styrene, 1 equivalent of gem-difluoroalkene, and 2 equivalents of DEMS at 25 °C for up to 10 hours under nitrogen.

A catalytic amount of TBAF was critical for reaction initiation, Na3PO4 and NaF were comparably effective, THF harmed both reactivity and enantioselectivity, and operation at 0 °C lowered the yield somewhat.

The successful scope includes electron-rich and electron-poor styrenes, multiple substitution patterns and functional groups, several heterocycles, β-unsubstituted styrenes, and gem-difluoroalkenes bearing aryl, heteroaryl, or alkyl substituents and varied ester groups.
No desired dehalogenative cross-coupling product was observed with the tested gem-dichloroalkene or with a gem-difluoroalkene lacking the ester group under the reported conditions.

For migratory coupling, L1* alone gave low reactivity and moderate regioselectivity, whereas adding an achiral chain-walking ligand improved catalytic efficiency and regioselectivity without significant loss of enantioselectivity; the dual-ligand system supported terminal and internal unactivated alkenes.
Under dual-ligand migratory conditions, a styrene isomer accumulated during reaction monitoring.

The authors interpret styrene-isomer accumulation as evidence that alkene isomerization is faster than asymmetric hydroalkenylation, and interpret isotope-labeling results as indicating that the achiral ligand participates in isomerization but minimally, if at all, in styrene hydroalkenylation.

A Ni(0) catalyst did not produce the desired model product, and an electron-deficient CF3-substituted radical acceptor did not furnish the proposed radical-trapping/β-fluoride-elimination product, including when the gem-difluoroalkene coupling partner was absent.

An (E)-monofluoroalkene was also a coupling partner, with slight erosion of enantioselectivity and no observed isomerized (Z)-product; unlike the standard gem-difluoroalkene scope, this example did not require an ester directing group for the reported C-F activation.
作者开发了流动体系中的C(sp3)-F键官能化方法，通过萘钾对三氟甲基化合物进行瞬时电子诱导的极性反转，并经由二氟甲基负离子获得多种二氟甲基化合物。
在无亲电试剂条件下，作者发现于间歇反应器中生成高度不稳定的二氟甲基负离子具有挑战性；作者使用流动微反应器控制这类不稳定活性物种。

Countercation identity strongly affected the reaction: lithium gave only trace desired product, while sodium and potassium improved difluoromethylbenzene yield, with the organopotassium reductant giving the best selective hydrodefluorination.

In-line IR after mixing benzotrifluoride and KNp for 0.31 s at -78 °C showed loss of a substrate-associated peak and appearance of two peaks assigned to intermediate 2a; calculated peaks in the same region supported, but did not independently prove, the difluoromethyl-anion assignment.
The authors propose that DME coordination draws potassium away from naphthalene, facilitating faster electron transfer and formation of difluoromethyl anion 2a.
在-78 °C且第一反应器停留时间tR1为0.11 s时，反应达到96%转化率和77%收率，过度反应副产物降至痕量。
Longer residence times or higher temperatures substantially decreased yield, establishing strict residence-time and temperature control as an explicit condition boundary.
The generated fluorinated carbanion was trapped by several electrophile classes: carbonyl compounds and an imine gave target products, and primary alkyl iodides furnished R-CF2-alkyl products.

Benzoyl chloride was incompatible with simultaneous exposure to KNp because benzoyl chloride reduction outcompeted the desired defluorinative reaction and the trifluoromethyl substrate was quantitatively recovered.
The method installed phosphoryl, halo, silyl, stannyl, and sulfide groups in moderate yields, but the tested boron electrophiles were not suitable.
Further defluorination is experimentally possible under the reaction manifold: difluoromethylbenzene underwent hydrodefluorination to fluoromethylbenzene.

The paper experimentally studies a palladium-catalysed C-C cross-coupling of aryl halides with terminal alkynes by separating a proposed dual-palladium mechanism into independently investigated elementary reactions.
作者由碘、溴或氯代单乙炔基钯 5 制得双乙炔基钯 6；另以炔烃 2 和 LnPdIIX2 为原料进行碱介导反应。两种方法合计制备了含芳基、杂芳基或烷基取代炔配体的对称双乙炔基钯，并将方法 A 用于相应的不对称双乙炔基钯。
在所报告的 CDCl3、298 K、2 h 条件下，所有受研究的双乙炔基钯 6 与氧化加成配合物 7 的反应均形成相应内炔 3；所提出的 B 类转金属化中间体在这些反应中均未被检测到。

Pd-Pd transmetallation reactivity depended strongly on the oxidative-addition-complex halide and on partner electronics: Cl > Br > OAc > I, electron-donating substituents on the electrophilic complex accelerated reaction, and electron-withdrawing substituents on the bisacetylide accelerated reaction.
在与 7a 的比较实验中，含碘、溴或氯的单乙炔基钯 5a、5b、5c 均比双乙炔基钯 6a 反应迟缓。

Excess PPh3 completely stopped the stoichiometric reaction of 6a with 7a and slowed the catalytic reaction, while pyrrolidine altered oxidative-addition-complex speciation by replacing a phosphine ligand.

The authors propose a dissociative Pd-Pd transmetallation pathway initiated by PPh3 loss, followed by association through a cyclic intermediate containing bridging alkyne and iodide ligands; dissociation of a later Pd-Pd complex is proposed as the most likely rate-determining step of that stoichiometric process.
由于 6a 由 5a 和 2a 形成的速率几乎与所研究催化反应的速率一致，作者认为该多步形成过程中的某个过渡态最可能构成所研究催化反应的决速步骤。

Chloride addition accelerated the model catalytic coupling by two- to three-fold, and chloride rapidly exchanged with iodide in both the oxidative-addition complex and palladium monoacetylide; chloride and pyrrolidine did not affect the palladium bisacetylide by 31P NMR.
作者警告，该反应的决速步骤尚未得到清楚确认，并可能位于形成关键拟议机理中间体的任一多步过程中。
反应 2–4 小时后出现额外的 31P NMR 共振，作者认为这可能源于配合物分解及所形成物种之间的副反应；作者还指出，在所研究的 Pd-Pd 转金属化中，氧化加成配合物在反应期间的分解降低了观察到的反应速率。

Transition-metal-catalyzed functionalization of gem-difluoroalkenes commonly proceeds through beta-fluoroalkylmetal intermediates followed by beta-fluoride elimination to form monofluoroalkene products; formation of a strong metal-fluoride bond provides a thermodynamic driving force.

Visible-light Ir-catalyzed defluorinative cross-coupling of gem-difluoroalkenes with thiols regioselectively produced monofluoroalkenes; monosubstituted and disubstituted gem-difluoroalkenes favored different solvents.
The visible-light thiol coupling reportedly accommodated aryl thiols, simple alkyl thiols, and natural-product-linked thiols.
协同光氧化还原与氢原子转移催化可使多种胺、醚和硫醚参与区域选择性单氟烯基化，生成带α-杂原子取代基的单氟烯烃；对于所述胺实例，引文提出先形成α-氨基烷基自由基，再经自由基异二聚形成产物。

A base-promoted intramolecular nitrogen attack on a gem-difluoroalkene followed by beta-fluoride elimination generated N-substituted 2-fluoroindoles, but formation of the required amino-difluorovinyl precursor first used a Pd-catalyzed Buchwald-Hartwig coupling.

Phenols and 4-hydroxypyridine participated in base-mediated substitution chemistry of a specialized bromophenyl gem-difluoroalkene, followed by a separate Pd-catalyzed cyclization; the phenol sequence involved substitution of both olefinic C-F bonds rather than selective monodefluorination.

Copper catalyst systems can be tuned to activate both C-F bonds of gem-difluoroalkenes and produce multiple borylation states; Cu salt, additive, solvent, and temperature optimization controlled the product distribution.
对于引文所述的脂肪族偕二氟烯烃和反应条件，脱氟硅基化未生成产物26i，而脱氟硼化得到产物27i，收率为50%。
The review proposes that the Cu defluorinative borylation and silylation mechanisms likely involve regioselective olefin insertion followed by syn-coplanar beta-fluoride elimination.
该综述指出，多数情况下β-芳基-α,α-二氟烯烃表现良好，而相应β-烷基-α,α-二氟烯烃的反应情况仍不清楚，或会形成不同产物。

Metal geometry can prevent defluorination: when the fluorinated carbon is alpha rather than beta to the metal center, facile beta-fluoride elimination is unavailable and fluorine-retentive products can result.
The reported reaction is a palladium-catalyzed aminocarbonylation of aryl chlorides with ammonia.
Ethylene complex 1 serves as the catalyst, and mechanistic information was obtained through isolation of catalytic intermediates and kinetic measurements.
Arylpalladium and phenacylpalladium halide intermediates were synthesized, and their formation and reactions were studied kinetically.

Oxidative addition of aryl chlorides and bromides was determined to proceed through rate-limiting reaction of the haloarene with a three-coordinate Pd(0) species bearing a bidentate phosphine and one CO ligand.
A primary carbon-13 kinetic isotope effect was interpreted as suggesting carbon-halogen bond cleavage during the rate-limiting oxidative-addition step.

The authors assign benzamide formation from a phenacylpalladium chloride complex and ammonia to reversible chloride displacement by ammonia, deprotonation of coordinated ammonia to a phenacylpalladium amido complex, and C-N-forming reductive elimination.
Reaction of an arylpalladium amido complex with CO produced the corresponding primary benzamide, supporting the assigned mechanism.
Formation of a Pd(I) dimer was identified as a catalyst-deactivation pathway.
